### `/speech-game-sw.js` (api, public)

```typescript
import type { Context } from "hono";

const SW_CODE = `
const CACHE_NAME = "sblend-v1";
const PRECACHE = [
  "/speech-game",
  "/speech-game/stickers",
  "/icons/speech-game-192.png",
  "/icons/speech-game-512.png",
];

self.addEventListener("install", (e) => {
  e.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.addAll(PRECACHE)).then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (e) => {
  e.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((keys) =>
      Promise.all(keys.filter((k) => k !== CACHE_NAME).map((k) => caches.delete(k)))
    ).then(() => self.clients.claim())
  );
});

self.addEventListener("fetch", (e) => {
  const url = new URL(e.request.url);
  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) return;
  if (e.request.method !== "GET") return;
  e.respondWith(
    fetch(e.request)
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.ok) {
          const clone = res.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.put(e.request, clone));
        }
        return res;
      })
      .catch(() => caches.match(e.request))
  );
});
`;

export default (c: Context) => {
  return new Response(SW_CODE.trim(), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/javascript",
      "Service-Worker-Allowed": "/",
      "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
    },
  });
};
```

### `/speech-game/stats` (page, public)

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

const AUTH_KEY = "sblend-auth";

interface Attempt {
  id: string; word: string; phrase: string; position: "first" | "second";
  round: number; tries: number; date: string; time: string; timestamp: number;
}

interface StickerInfo { sticker: string; appliedAt: string }
interface ServerData { attempts: Attempt[]; stickers: { [date: string]: StickerInfo } }

const WORD_EMOJIS: { [k: string]: string } = {
  smell: "🌸", sneeze: "🤧", swing: "🎠", small: "🐜", stop: "🛑", spoon: "🥄",
  swim: "🏊", star: "⭐", smile: "😊", snack: "🍪", snow: "❄️", space: "🚀",
};

const COLORS = [
  "#8b5cf6","#3b82f6","#10b981","#f59e0b","#ef4444","#ec4899",
  "#06b6d4","#84cc16","#f97316","#6366f1","#14b8a6","#e11d48",
];

function BarChart({ data, maxVal, title, color }: {
  data: { label: string; value: number; sublabel?: string }[];
  maxVal: number; title: string; color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100">
      <h3 className="font-black text-gray-700 text-sm sm:text-base mb-3">{title}</h3>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {data.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-gray-600 w-16 sm:w-20 truncate text-right">{d.label}</span>
            <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-5 sm:h-6 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700 flex items-center justify-end pr-2"
                style={{ width: `${maxVal > 0 ? Math.max((d.value / maxVal) * 100, 8) : 8}%`, backgroundColor: color || COLORS[i % COLORS.length] }}>
                <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold text-white drop-shadow">{d.value}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            {d.sublabel && <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 w-10">{d.sublabel}</span>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DonutChart({ segments, centerText, centerSub, size }: {
  segments: { value: number; color: string; label: string }[];
  centerText: string; centerSub: string; size?: number;
}) {
  const s = size || 120;
  const total = segments.reduce((a, b) => a + b.value, 0);
  let cumulative = 0;
  const strokes = segments.map(seg => {
    const pct = total > 0 ? (seg.value / total) * 100 : 0;
    const dash = `${pct} ${100 - pct}`;
    const rotate = cumulative * 3.6;
    cumulative += pct;
    return { ...seg, dash, rotate, pct };
  });
  const r = 40;
  const circ = 2 * Math.PI * r;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <div className="relative" style={{ width: s, height: s }}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="w-full h-full -rotate-90">
          <circle cx="50" cy="50" r={r} fill="none" stroke="#f3f4f6" strokeWidth="14" />
          {strokes.map((seg, i) => (
            seg.value > 0 && <circle key={i} cx="50" cy="50" r={r} fill="none"
              stroke={seg.color} strokeWidth="14"
              strokeDasharray={`${(seg.value / total) * circ} ${circ}`}
              strokeDashoffset={`${-strokes.slice(0, i).reduce((a, b) => a + (b.value / total) * circ, 0)}`}
              className="transition-all duration-700" />
          ))}
        </svg>
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800">{centerText}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-500">{centerSub}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 mt-2 justify-center">
        {segments.map((seg, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: seg.color }} />
            <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-600">{seg.label} ({seg.value})</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function StatsPage() {
  const [isAuth, setIsAuth] = useState(false);
  const [passcode, setPasscode] = useState("");
  const [authLoading, setAuthLoading] = useState(true);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState("");
  const [data, setData] = useState<ServerData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<"all" | "7d" | "30d">("all");

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      fetch("/api/speech-game-auth", { headers: { "X-Passcode": saved } })
        .then(r => { if (r.ok) { setIsAuth(true); setPasscode(saved); } else localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_KEY); setAuthLoading(false); })
        .catch(() => setAuthLoading(false));
    } else setAuthLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuth) return;
    const pc = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_KEY) || "";
    fetch("/api/speech-game-data", { headers: { "X-Passcode": pc } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { setData(d); setLoading(false); })
      .catch(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [isAuth]);

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); if (!passcode) return; setAuthLoading(true); setAuthError("");
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/speech-game-auth", { headers: { "X-Passcode": passcode } });
      if (res.ok) { localStorage.setItem(AUTH_KEY, passcode); setIsAuth(true); } else setAuthError("Wrong passcode");
    } catch { setAuthError("Connection error"); }
    setAuthLoading(false);
  };

  if (authLoading) {
    return (<div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-green-50 via-blue-50 to-purple-50 flex items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-green-500" /></div>);
  }
  if (!isAuth) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-green-50 via-blue-50 to-purple-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-xl w-full max-w-sm space-y-6">
          <div className="flex justify-center"><div className="w-16 h-16 bg-green-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center"><Lock className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" /></div></div>
          <div className="text-center"><h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-green-700">Speech Stats</h2><p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Enter the passcode to view</p></div>
          {authError && <p className="text-sm text-center text-red-500 bg-red-50 p-2 rounded-lg">{authError}</p>}
          <input type="password" value={passcode} onChange={e => setPasscode(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-green-200 text-center text-lg tracking-widest focus:border-green-500 focus:outline-none" placeholder="••••••" autoFocus />
          <button type="submit" disabled={authLoading || !passcode}
            className="w-full py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-teal-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold shadow disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center">
            {authLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : "Unlock 🔓"}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading || !data) {
    return (<div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-green-50 via-blue-50 to-purple-50 flex items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-green-500" /></div>);
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const cutoff = dateRange === "7d" ? now - 7 * 86400000 : dateRange === "30d" ? now - 30 * 86400000 : 0;
  const attempts = data.attempts.filter(a => (a.timestamp || 0) >= cutoff);

  const totalAttempts = attempts.length;
  const totalTries = attempts.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.tries || 1), 0);
  const totalRetries = totalTries - totalAttempts;
  const overallAccuracy = totalTries > 0 ? Math.round((totalAttempts / totalTries) * 100) : 0;
  const uniqueDays = new Set(attempts.map(a => a.date)).size;
  const totalStickers = Object.keys(data.stickers).length;

  const stickerDays = Object.keys(data.stickers).sort();
  const todayStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");

  // Position stats
  const firstCount = attempts.filter(a => a.position === "first").length;
  const secondCount = attempts.filter(a => a.position === "second").length;
  const firstTries = attempts.filter(a => a.position === "first").reduce((s, a) => s + (a.tries || 1), 0);
  const secondTries = attempts.filter(a => a.position === "second").reduce((s, a) => s + (a.tries || 1), 0);
  const firstAccuracy = firstTries > 0 ? Math.round((firstCount / firstTries) * 100) : 0;
  const secondAccuracy = secondTries > 0 ? Math.round((secondCount / secondTries) * 100) : 0;

  // Per-word stats
  const wordStats: { [w: string]: { attempts: number; tries: number; firstTries: number; secondTries: number; firstCount: number; secondCount: number } } = {};
  const allWords = Object.keys(WORD_EMOJIS);
  allWords.forEach(w => { wordStats[w] = { attempts: 0, tries: 0, firstTries: 0, secondTries: 0, firstCount: 0, secondCount: 0 }; });
  attempts.forEach(a => {
    if (!wordStats[a.word]) wordStats[a.word] = { attempts: 0, tries: 0, firstTries: 0, secondTries: 0, firstCount: 0, secondCount: 0 };
    wordStats[a.word].attempts++;
    wordStats[a.word].tries += a.tries || 1;
    if (a.position === "first") { wordStats[a.word].firstTries += a.tries || 1; wordStats[a.word].firstCount++; }
    else { wordStats[a.word].secondTries += a.tries || 1; wordStats[a.word].secondCount++; }
  });

  const wordsByRetries = [...allWords].sort((a, b) => (wordStats[b]?.tries || 0) - (wordStats[a]?.tries || 0));
  const wordsByAccuracy = [...allWords].sort((a, b) => {
    const accA = wordStats[a]?.tries > 0 ? (wordStats[a].attempts / wordStats[a].tries) : 1;
    const accB = wordStats[b]?.tries > 0 ? (wordStats[b].attempts / wordStats[b].tries) : 1;
    return accA - accB;
  });

  const maxWordTries = Math.max(...allWords.map(w => wordStats[w]?.tries || 0), 1);

  // Sticker streaks
  let currentStickerStreak = 0;
  let bestStickerStreak = 0;
  let rollingStickerStreak = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < stickerDays.length; i++) {
    if (i === 0) {
      rollingStickerStreak = 1;
    } else {
      const prev = new Date(stickerDays[i - 1] + "T12:00:00");
      const curr = new Date(stickerDays[i] + "T12:00:00");
      const diff = Math.round((curr.getTime() - prev.getTime()) / 86400000);
      rollingStickerStreak = diff === 1 ? rollingStickerStreak + 1 : 1;
    }
    bestStickerStreak = Math.max(bestStickerStreak, rollingStickerStreak);
  }

  if (stickerDays.length > 0) {
    const lastSticker = new Date(stickerDays[stickerDays.length - 1] + "T12:00:00");
    const today = new Date(todayStr + "T12:00:00");
    const daysSinceLastSticker = Math.round((today.getTime() - lastSticker.getTime()) / 86400000);

    if (daysSinceLastSticker <= 1) {
      currentStickerStreak = rollingStickerStreak;
    }
  }

  // Recent activity (last 7 days) counts total tries, not completed answers
  const last7 = Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(now - (6 - i) * 86400000);
    const ds = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA");
    const dayAttempts = data.attempts.filter(a => a.date === ds);
    const dayLabel = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { weekday: "short" });
    const tries = dayAttempts.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.tries || 1), 0);
    return { label: dayLabel, value: tries };
  });
  const maxDaily = Math.max(...last7.map(d => d.value), 1);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-green-50 via-blue-50 to-purple-50 p-2 sm:p-4 pb-24">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <a href="/speech-game" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm hover:underline">← Game</a>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-green-700">Speech Stats 📊</h1>
          <a href="/speech-game/stickers" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm hover:underline">Stickers ⭐</a>
        </div>

        {/* Date range filter */}
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-2 mb-4">
          {(["all", "7d", "30d"] as const).map(r => (
            <button key={r} onClick={() => setDateRange(r)}
              className={`px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all
                ${dateRange === r ? "bg-green-500 text-white shadow" : "bg-white text-gray-600 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>
              {r === "all" ? "All Time" : r === "7d" ? "7 Days" : "30 Days"}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {totalAttempts === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 shadow-sm text-center">
            <div className="text-5xl mb-3">🎯</div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-gray-700">No data yet!</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Play the game to see your stats here.</p>
            <a href="/speech-game" className="inline-block mt-4 bg-green-500 text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-green-600 transition">
              Play Now 🎮
            </a>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Summary cards */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 sm:gap-3 mb-4">
              {[
                { emoji: "🎯", label: "Words Done", value: totalAttempts, color: "from-purple-400 to-indigo-400" },
                { emoji: "🔄", label: "Retries", value: totalRetries, color: "from-orange-400 to-red-400" },
                { emoji: "📐", label: "Accuracy", value: `${overallAccuracy}%`, color: "from-green-400 to-emerald-400" },
                { emoji: "📅", label: "Days Played", value: uniqueDays, color: "from-blue-400 to-cyan-400" },
              ].map((c, i) => (
                <div key={i} className={`bg-gradient-to-br ${c.color} rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 text-white text-center shadow`}>
                  <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl">{c.emoji}</div>
                  <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black mt-1">{c.value}</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs opacity-80 font-semibold">{c.label}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Streak + stickers */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:gap-3 mb-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-green-100 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl">🔥</div>
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-orange-600">{currentStickerStreak}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-500 font-semibold">Current Sticker Streak</div>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-green-100 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl">🏆</div>
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-600">{bestStickerStreak}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-500 font-semibold">Best Sticker Streak</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 mb-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-green-100 text-center">
                <div className="text-3xl">⭐</div>
                <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-yellow-600">{totalStickers}</div>
                <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-500 font-semibold">Stickers Earned</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Position comparison donut */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-black text-gray-700 text-sm sm:text-base mb-3 text-center">Word Position: First vs Second</h3>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-around gap-4">
                <DonutChart
                  segments={[
                    { value: firstCount, color: "#8b5cf6", label: "1st in phrase" },
                    { value: secondCount, color: "#3b82f6", label: "2nd in phrase" },
                  ]}
                  centerText={`${totalAttempts}`}
                  centerSub="total picks"
                />
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <div className="bg-purple-50 rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-purple-600">Word FIRST</div>
                    <div className="text-lg font-black text-purple-800">{firstCount} picks</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-purple-500">{firstAccuracy}% accuracy</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{firstTries} total tries</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-blue-50 rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600">Word SECOND</div>
                    <div className="text-lg font-black text-blue-800">{secondCount} picks</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-blue-500">{secondAccuracy}% accuracy</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{secondTries} total tries</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Accuracy by position per word */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-black text-gray-700 text-sm sm:text-base mb-3">Position Accuracy by Word</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {allWords.map((w, i) => {
                  const ws = wordStats[w];
                  const fAcc = ws.firstTries > 0 ? Math.round((ws.firstCount / ws.firstTries) * 100) : -1;
                  const sAcc = ws.secondTries > 0 ? Math.round((ws.secondCount / ws.secondTries) * 100) : -1;
                  return (
                    <div key={w} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-base">{WORD_EMOJIS[w]}</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 w-12 sm:w-14 truncate">{w}</span>
                      <div className="flex-1 flex gap-1">
                        <div className="flex-1 bg-purple-50 rounded-full h-4 overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-purple-400 transition-all duration-500"
                            style={{ width: fAcc >= 0 ? `${fAcc}%` : "0%", opacity: fAcc >= 0 ? 1 : 0.2 }} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 bg-blue-50 rounded-full h-4 overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-blue-400 transition-all duration-500"
                            style={{ width: sAcc >= 0 ? `${sAcc}%` : "0%", opacity: sAcc >= 0 ? 1 : 0.2 }} />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2 text-[10px] w-20 text-right">
                        <span className="text-purple-600 font-bold">{fAcc >= 0 ? `${fAcc}%` : "-"}</span>
                        <span className="text-blue-600 font-bold">{sAcc >= 0 ? `${sAcc}%` : "-"}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-center gap-4 mt-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1"><div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-purple-400" /><span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">1st pos</span></div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1"><div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-400" /><span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">2nd pos</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Most retries */}
            <BarChart
              title="Most Retries by Word 🔄"
              data={wordsByRetries.slice(0, 6).map(w => ({
                label: `${WORD_EMOJIS[w]} ${w}`,
                value: (wordStats[w]?.tries || 0) - (wordStats[w]?.attempts || 0),
                sublabel: `${wordStats[w]?.attempts || 0} done`,
              }))}
              maxVal={Math.max(...wordsByRetries.slice(0, 6).map(w => (wordStats[w]?.tries || 0) - (wordStats[w]?.attempts || 0)), 1)}
              color="#f97316"
            />

            {/* Best words */}
            <div className="mt-4">
              <BarChart
                title="Best Words (Highest Accuracy) 🌟"
                data={wordsByAccuracy.reverse().slice(0, 6).map(w => {
                  const ws = wordStats[w];
                  const acc = ws.tries > 0 ? Math.round((ws.attempts / ws.tries) * 100) : 0;
                  return { label: `${WORD_EMOJIS[w]} ${w}`, value: acc, sublabel: `${ws.attempts} done` };
                })}
                maxVal={100}
                color="#10b981"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Worst words */}
            <div className="mt-4">
              <BarChart
                title="Words to Practice More 📝"
                data={wordsByAccuracy.reverse().slice(0, 6).map(w => {
                  const ws = wordStats[w];
                  const acc = ws.tries > 0 ? Math.round((ws.attempts / ws.tries) * 100) : 0;
                  return { label: `${WORD_EMOJIS[w]} ${w}`, value: acc, sublabel: `${ws.attempts} done` };
                })}
                maxVal={100}
                color="#ef4444"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Per-word detail grid */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 mt-4">
              <h3 className="font-black text-gray-700 text-sm sm:text-base mb-3">Word Detail Grid</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 landscape:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {allWords.map((w, i) => {
                  const ws = wordStats[w];
                  const acc = ws.tries > 0 ? Math.round((ws.attempts / ws.tries) * 100) : 0;
                  const retries = ws.tries - ws.attempts;
                  return (
                    <div key={w} className={`rounded-xl p-2.5 sm:p-3 border-2 ${acc >= 80 ? "border-green-300 bg-green-50" : acc >= 50 ? "border-yellow-300 bg-yellow-50" : acc > 0 ? "border-red-300 bg-red-50" : "border-gray-200 bg-gray-50"}`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                        <span className="text-lg">{WORD_EMOJIS[w]}</span>
                        <span className="font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-800">{w}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-gray-500 space-y-0.5">
                        <div>Done: <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{ws.attempts}</span></div>
                        <div>Accuracy: <span className={`font-bold ${acc >= 80 ? "text-green-600" : acc >= 50 ? "text-yellow-600" : "text-red-600"}`}>{acc}%</span></div>
                        <div>Retries: <span className="font-bold text-orange-600">{retries}</span></div>
                        <div className="flex gap-1 text-[9px]">
                          <span className="text-purple-500">1st:{ws.firstCount}</span>
                          <span className="text-blue-500">2nd:{ws.secondCount}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Activity chart - last 7 days */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 shadow-sm border border-purple-100 mt-4">
              <h3 className="font-black text-gray-700 text-sm sm:text-base mb-3">Last 7 Days Total Tries</h3>
              <div className="flex items-end gap-1 sm:gap-2 h-28 sm:h-32">
                {last7.map((d, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-end h-full">
                    <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">{d.value > 0 ? d.value : ""}</span>
                    <div className="w-full rounded-t-lg transition-all duration-500 bg-gradient-to-t from-blue-400 to-purple-400"
                      style={{ height: `${maxDaily > 0 ? (d.value / maxDaily) * 80 : 0}%`, minHeight: d.value > 0 ? 8 : 2, opacity: d.value > 0 ? 1 : 0.2 }} />
                    <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-1">{d.label}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        <div className="mt-6 text-center flex justify-center gap-4">
          <a href="/speech-game" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm hover:underline">← Game</a>
          <a href="/speech-game/stickers" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm hover:underline">Stickers ⭐</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `/speech-game/stickers` (page, public)

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Lock, Loader2, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

const STICKER_KEY = "sblend-sticker-chart";
const AUTH_KEY = "sblend-auth";
const WORDS = ["smell","sneeze","swing","small","stop","spoon","swim","star","smile","snack","snow","space"];
const STICKERS = ["⭐","🌟","🏆","🎖️","💎","🦄","🌈","🎉","🦋","🐬","🍦","🎨","🚀","💪","👑","🌺","🐶","🐱","🦊","🐼","🦁","🐯","🦕","🦖","🦈","🦅","🦜","🐢","🦈","🐙","🍕","🍔","🍭","🧁","🍓","🍩","🍪","🎂","🍫","🎈","🎁","🎪","🎯","🎪","🎭","❤️","💜","💙","💚","💛","🧡","🤍","🖤","😀","😎","🤩","😍","🥳","🤠","🧚","🧞","🧜","🦸","🤖","👾","🎃","🎅","🤶","🥇","🏅","🎪","🎵","🎶","🎸","🎮","🕹️","🏀","⚽","🏈","🏂","🏄","🛼","🚁","🚂","✈️","🛸","🌺","🌸","🌻","🌹","🌷","💐"];

function formatDateKey(d: Date) {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}
function formatDisplay(dStr: string) {
  const [y, m, day] = dStr.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(y, m - 1, day).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}
function today() { return formatDateKey(new Date()); }

export default function Stickers() {
  const [authed, setAuthed] = useState(false);
  const [passcode, setPasscode] = useState("");
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [activeStickers, setActiveStickers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [completedDates, setCompletedDates] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedSticker, setSelectedSticker] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [viewYear, setViewYear] = useState(new Date().getFullYear());
  const [viewMonth, setViewMonth] = useState(new Date().getMonth());

  const verify = async (code: string) => {
    const res = await fetch("/api/speech-game-auth", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Passcode": code },
    });
    return res.ok;
  };

  const loadServerData = async (code: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/speech-game-data", {
        headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${code}`, "X-Passcode": code, "Accept": "application/json" },
      });
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();
      setActiveStickers(data.stickers || {});

      const byDate: Record<string, boolean> = {};
      const attempts: any[] = data.attempts || [];
      const dates = [...new Set(attempts.map((a: any) => a.date))];
      for (const dt of dates) {
        const dayAttempts = attempts.filter((a: any) => a.date === dt);
        const wordRounds: Record<string, Set<number>> = {};
        for (const a of dayAttempts) {
          if (!wordRounds[a.word]) wordRounds[a.word] = new Set();
          wordRounds[a.word].add(a.round);
        }
        const allComplete = WORDS.every(w => {
          const rounds = wordRounds[w];
          return rounds && rounds.has(1) && rounds.has(2);
        });
        if (allComplete) byDate[dt] = true;
      }
      setCompletedDates(byDate);
    } catch {}
  };

  const login = async () => {
    if (!passcode) return;
    setLoading(true); 
    setAuthError("");
    
    const ok = await verify(passcode);
    if (ok) {
      localStorage.setItem(AUTH_KEY, passcode);
      setAuthed(true);
      await loadServerData(passcode);
    } else {
      setAuthError("Wrong passcode");
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("sblend-auth");
    if (saved) {
      setPasscode(saved);
      setAuthed(true);
      loadServerData(saved);
    }
  }, []);

  const applySticker = async (date: string) => {
    if (!selectedSticker) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const updated = { ...activeStickers, [date]: selectedSticker };
    setActiveStickers(updated);
    localStorage.setItem(STICKER_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    await fetch("/api/speech-game-data", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Passcode": passcode },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "saveStickers", stickers: updated }),
    });
    setSelectedDate(null); setSelectedSticker(null);
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const removeSticker = async (date: string) => {
    const updated = { ...activeStickers };
    delete updated[date];
    setActiveStickers(updated);
    localStorage.setItem(STICKER_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    await fetch("/api/speech-game-data", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Passcode": passcode },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "saveStickers", stickers: updated }),
    });
    setSelectedDate(null);
  };

  const firstDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1);
  const lastDay = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth + 1, 0);
  const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
  const startDow = firstDay.getDay();
  const monthDays: string[] = [];
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    monthDays.push(formatDateKey(new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, d)));
  }

  const prevMonth = () => {
    if (viewMonth === 0) { setViewMonth(11); setViewYear(viewYear - 1); }
    else setViewMonth(viewMonth - 1);
  };
  const nextMonth = () => {
    if (viewMonth === 11) { setViewMonth(0); setViewYear(viewYear + 1); }
    else setViewMonth(viewMonth + 1);
  };
  const monthName = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "long", year: "numeric" });
  const todayStr = today();

  if (!authed) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-pink-50 to-purple-100 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-8 max-w-sm w-full text-center">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">🏆</div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-700 mb-2">Reward Chart</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-6">Enter your passcode to access the reward chart</p>
          <input type="password" value={passcode} onChange={(e: any) => setPasscode(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e: any) => e.key === "Enter" && login()}
            className="w-full px-4 py-3 border-2 border-purple-200 rounded-xl text-center text-lg tracking-widest focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
            placeholder="••••" maxLength={8} />
          {authError && <p className="mt-3 text-red-500 text-sm font-bold">{authError}</p>}
          <button onClick={login} disabled={loading}
            className="mt-4 w-full bg-purple-600 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50">
            {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : "Enter"}
          </button>
          <div className="mt-6 text-center">
            <a href="/speech-game" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-sm hover:underline">← Back to Game</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-pink-50 to-purple-100 p-4 sm:p-6">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <div className="text-center mb-4">
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-purple-700">🏆 Reward Chart</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">Tap any past day or today to add a sticker. Future dates are blocked.</p>
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 mt-3 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <a href="/speech-game" className="text-purple-600 font-bold hover:underline">← Game</a>
            <a href="/speech-game/stats" className="text-purple-600 font-bold hover:underline">Stats →</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Legend */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center mb-3 text-xs">
          <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded-full font-bold">✅ Completed</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 rounded-full font-bold">⭐ Sticker</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-50 text-blue-500 rounded-full font-bold">📅 Today</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 rounded-full font-bold">🚫 Future blocked</span>
        </div>

        {/* Month navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 px-1">
          <button onClick={prevMonth} className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white shadow hover:bg-purple-50 transition-colors">
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 text-purple-600" />
          </button>
          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-purple-700">{monthName}</h2>
          <button onClick={nextMonth} className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white shadow hover:bg-purple-50 transition-colors">
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 text-purple-600" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Calendar grid - MOBILE RESPONSIVE */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-2 sm:p-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
            {["S","M","T","W","T","F","S"].map((d, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="text-center text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 py-1">{d}</div>
            ))}
            {Array.from({ length: startDow }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={`off-${i}`} />
            ))}
            {monthDays.map(dateStr => {
              const isComplete = !!completedDates[dateStr];
              const hasSticker = !!activeStickers[dateStr];
              const isToday = dateStr === todayStr;
              const isSelected = selectedDate === dateStr;
              const dayNum = parseInt(dateStr.split("-")[2]);
              const isFuture = dateStr > todayStr;
              const canSelect = !isFuture;
              
              let cls = "aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ";
              if (hasSticker) cls += "bg-purple-100 border-2 border-purple-400 cursor-pointer ";
              else if (isComplete) cls += "bg-green-100 border-2 border-green-400 cursor-pointer ";
              else if (isToday) cls += "bg-blue-50 border-2 border-blue-300 cursor-pointer ";
              else if (isFuture) cls += "bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed ";
              else cls += "bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 cursor-pointer hover:border-purple-300 ";
              if (isSelected) cls += "ring-2 ring-yellow-400 scale-105 ";
              
              return (
                <div key={dateStr} className={cls}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (canSelect) {
                      setSelectedDate(dateStr);
                      setSelectedSticker(activeStickers[dateStr] || null);
                    }
                  }}
                  title={formatDisplay(dateStr)}>
                  <span className="text-base sm:text-lg">{activeStickers[dateStr] || (isComplete ? "✅" : isToday ? "📅" : isFuture ? "🚫" : "⭐")}</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-400 text-[10px] sm:text-xs">{dayNum}</span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary */}
        <div className="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-gray-400">
          {Object.keys(completedDates).length} completed · {Object.keys(activeStickers).length} stickers
        </div>

        {/* Sticker picker modal */}
        {selectedDate && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center z-50" 
               onClick={() => { setSelectedDate(null); setSelectedSticker(null); }}>
            <div className="bg-white rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full sm:max-w-md max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col" 
                 onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className="p-4 pb-2 border-b border-gray-100 shrink-0">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-center text-purple-700">Pick a Sticker!</h2>
                <p className="text-center text-gray-400 text-xs">{formatDisplay(selectedDate)}</p>
                {!completedDates[selectedDate] && (
                  <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-orange-500 mt-1 font-semibold">Manual completion mode</p>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 p-3">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-1.5">
                  {STICKERS.map(s => (
                    <button key={s} onClick={() => setSelectedSticker(s)}
                      className={`aspect-square text-2xl sm:text-3xl rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${
                        selectedSticker === s ? "bg-purple-100 ring-2 ring-purple-500 scale-110" : "bg-gray-50 hover:bg-purple-50"
                      }`}>
                      {s}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {activeStickers[selectedDate] && (
                <div className="text-center py-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0">
                  <span className="text-2xl">{activeStickers[selectedDate]}</span>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Current sticker</p>
                </div>
              )}
              
              <div className="flex gap-2 p-4 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0">
                <button onClick={() => { setSelectedDate(null); setSelectedSticker(null); }}
                  className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-200 font-bold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-300 text-sm">Cancel</button>
                <button onClick={() => applySticker(selectedDate)} disabled={!selectedSticker || saving}
                  className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 text-white font-bold hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
                  {saving ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : "✓ Apply"}
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {activeStickers[selectedDate] && (
                <div className="px-4 pb-4 shrink-0">
                  <button onClick={() => removeSticker(selectedDate)}
                    className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-red-100 text-red-600 font-bold text-xs hover:bg-red-200">
                    🗑️ Remove sticker
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 text-center">
          <a href="/speech-game" className="text-purple-600 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm hover:underline">← Back to Game</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `/telemetry` (page, private)

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Menu, X, ArrowLeft, Activity, RefreshCw, Terminal, Users, Zap, TrendingUp, Lock, ExternalLink, LayoutDashboard, Palette, Settings, Share2, Clock, Briefcase, Sparkles, PenLine } from "lucide-react";

const C = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f", card: "#0f1117", cyan: "#06b6d4", cyanL: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1", muted: "#94a3b8", dim: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
};

const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
  "pencil": PenLine, "palette": Palette, "settings": Settings,
  "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard, "sparkles": Sparkles,
  "share-2": Share2, "clock": Clock, "briefcase": Briefcase,
  "activity": Activity, "lock": Lock, "kanban": Settings,
};

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { setNavLinks(d.links || []); setNavAuth(d.authenticated); })
      .catch(() => {});
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setNavOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
  }, []);

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);
  const CN = { cyan: "#06b6d4", cyanL: "#22d3ee", indigo: "#6366f1", indigoL: "#818cf8", muted: "#94a3b8", dim: "#64748b", border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="hidden md:block fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999]" ref={navRef}>
        <div className="relative">
          <button onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-colors border"
            style={{ borderColor: CN.border }}>
            {navOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: CN.cyan }} /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: CN.cyan }} />}
          </button>
          {navOpen && (
            <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-3 min-w-[250px] w-max max-w-md rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
              style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: "1px solid " + CN.border }}>
              {navAuth && (
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid " + CN.border, color: CN.cyan }}>
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" /><span>Authenticated view</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="py-2 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                  const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                  return (
                    <a key={link.path} href={link.path} onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 group">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                        style={{ background: link.category === "private" ? CN.indigo + "15" : CN.cyan + "15", border: "1px solid " + (link.category === "private" ? CN.indigo + "30" : CN.cyan + "30") }}>
                        <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? CN.indigoL : CN.cyan }} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">{link.name}</span>
                          {link.category === "private" && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider"
                              style={{ background: CN.indigo + "20", color: CN.indigoL }}>Private</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs mt-0.5 truncate" style={{ color: CN.dim }}>{link.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[9999]">
        {navOpen && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-16 right-0 mb-2 min-w-[200px] w-max max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
            style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.98)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: "1px solid " + CN.border }}>
            <div className="py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono tracking-widest uppercase" style={{ color: CN.dim }}>Pages</div>
              {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                return (
                  <a key={link.path} href={link.path} onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                    <div className="w-6 flex justify-center shrink-0">
                      <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? CN.indigoL : CN.cyan }} />
                    </div>
                    <span className="truncate">{link.name}</span>
                    {link.category === "private" && (
                      <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono"
                        style={{ background: CN.indigo + "20", color: CN.indigoL }}>Private</span>
                    )}
                  </a>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <button onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
          className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
          style={{ background: CN.cyan, color: "white", boxShadow: "0 4px 20px -5px " + CN.cyan + "60" }}>
          {navOpen ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-6 h-6" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

interface Nav { path: string; label: string; private: boolean; }
interface Skill { name: string; runs: number; success: number; fail: number; successRate: number; avgDurationMs: number; recentErrors: string[]; }
interface SessionDay { date: string; sessions: number; }

function fmtMs(ms: number) {
  if (ms < 1000) return ms + "ms";
  return (ms / 1000).toFixed(1) + "s";
}

export default function TelemetryDashboard() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"skills"|"sessions"|"models">("skills");
  const [days, setDays] = useState(30);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await fetch("/api/telemetry-data?days=" + days, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } });
      setData(await r.json());
    } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    setLoading(false);
  };
  useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [days]);

  const s = data?.summary || {};
  const skills = data?.skills || [];
  const sessionActivity = data?.sessionActivity || [];
  const modelUsage = data?.modelUsage || {};
  const maxSessions = Math.max(...sessionActivity.map((d: SessionDay) => d.sessions), 1);

  const gradient = "linear-gradient(135deg," + C.cyan + "," + C.indigo + ")";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen text-white font-body relative" style={{background: C.bg}}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-grid pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute pointer-events-none" style={{top:-200,left:-100,width:500,height:500,background:C.cyan,borderRadius:"50%",opacity:0.04,filter:"blur(150px)"}} />
      <div className="absolute pointer-events-none" style={{top:100,right:-150,width:400,height:400,background:C.indigo,borderRadius:"50%",opacity:0.03,filter:"blur(150px)"}} />

      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        .font-heading{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}
        .font-body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif}
        .font-mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
        .bg-grid{background-size:60px 60px;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(99,102,241,0.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(6,182,212,0.06) 1px,transparent 1px)}
        @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
        .anim-in{animation:fadeIn 0.5s ease-out forwards;opacity:0}
      `}</style>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 py-6">
        <GlobalNav />

        <header className="mb-8 anim-in">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono tracking-widest uppercase" style={{color: C.cyan}}>Zo Computer</span>
          <h1 className="font-heading text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold mt-2 mb-3">
            <span style={{background: gradient, WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent"}}>Telemetry Dashboard</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-lg max-w-xl" style={{color: C.muted}}>Skill executions, session activity, and model usage across your Zo Computer.</p>
        </header>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full animate-spin" style={{border: "2px solid " + C.cyan + "30", borderTopColor: C.cyan}} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
              {[
                {label: "Skill Runs", value: s.totalSkillRuns || 0, icon: <Terminal className="w-5 h-5" />, color: C.cyan},
                {label: "Success Rate", value: (s.overallSuccessRate || 0) + "%", icon: <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />, color: (s.overallSuccessRate || 0) >= 80 ? "#22c55e" : "#f59e0b"},
                {label: "Est. LLM Cost", value: "$" + (s.totalCost || 0), icon: <Zap className="w-5 h-5" />, color: C.indigo},
                {label: "Total Tokens", value: (s.totalTokens || 0).toLocaleString(), icon: <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />, color: "#f59e0b"},
              ].map((card, i) => (
                <div key={card.label} className="p-5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 anim-in" style={{background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.border, animationDelay: (i * 80) + "ms"}}
                  onMouseEnter={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor = C.cyan + "40"; }}
                  onMouseLeave={e => { (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor = C.border; }}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>{card.label}</p>
                    <div style={{color: card.color}}>{card.icon}</div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="font-heading text-2xl font-bold" style={{color: card.color}}>{card.value}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-8 anim-in" style={{animationDelay: "350ms"}}>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {(["skills", "sessions", "models"] as const).map(t => (
                  <button key={t} onClick={() => setTab(t)} className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase transition-all"
                    style={{background: tab === t ? gradient : "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", color: tab === t ? "white" : C.muted, border: "1px solid " + (tab === t ? "transparent" : C.border)}}>
                    {t}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 ml-auto">
                {[7, 30, 90].map(d => (
                  <button key={d} onClick={() => setDays(d)} className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-all"
                    style={{background: days === d ? C.cyan + "20" : "transparent", color: days === d ? C.cyan : C.dim, border: "1px solid " + (days === d ? C.cyan + "40" : "transparent")}}>
                    {d}d
                  </button>
                ))}
                <button onClick={fetchData} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors" style={{color: C.muted}} title="Refresh">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {tab === "skills" && (
              <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden anim-in" style={{background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.border, animationDelay: "450ms"}}>
                <div className="p-5 flex items-center justify-between" style={{borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.border}}>
                  <h2 className="font-heading text-lg font-semibold">Skill Executions</h2>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{color: C.dim}}>{skills.length} skills</span>
                </div>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full">
                    <thead>
                      <tr style={{borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.border}}>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>Skill</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>Runs</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>Success</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>Avg Duration</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase" style={{color: C.dim}}>Health</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {skills.map((sk: Skill) => (
                        <tr key={sk.name} className="transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.02]" style={{borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.border}}>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium">{sk.name}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono" style={{color: C.muted}}>{sk.runs}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono" style={{color: sk.successRate >= 80 ? "#22c55e" : sk.successRate >= 50 ? "#f59e0b" : "#ef4444"}}>{sk.successRate}%</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-mono" style={{color: C.muted}}>{fmtMs(sk.avgDurationMs)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3"><div className="w-24 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"}}><div className="h-full rounded-full" style={{width: sk.successRate + "%", background: sk.successRate >= 80 ? "#22c55e" : sk.successRate >= 50 ? "#f59e0b" : "#ef4444"}} /></div></td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {tab === "sessions" && (
              <div className="p-6 rounded-xl anim-in" style={{background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.border, animationDelay: "450ms"}}>
                <h2 className="font-heading text-lg font-semibold mb-5">Chat Session Activity</h2>
                <div className="flex items-end gap-2 h-40">
                  {sessionActivity.slice(0, 14).reverse().map((day: SessionDay, i: number) => (
                    <div key={day.date} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{color: C.dim}}>{day.sessions}</span>
                      <div className="w-full rounded-t-sm" style={{height: Math.max(4, (day.sessions / maxSessions) * 100) + "%", background: gradient, opacity: 0.7 + (i / sessionActivity.length) * 0.3}} />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{color: C.dim}}>{day.date.slice(5)}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {tab === "models" && (
              <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden anim-in" style={{background: C.card, border: "1px solid " + C.border, animationDelay: "450ms"}}>
                <div className="p-5" style={{borderBottom: "1px solid " + C.border}}>
                  <h2 className="font-heading text-lg font-semibold">Model Usage</h2>
                </div>
                <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
                  {Object.entries(modelUsage).sort(([,a],[,b]) => (b as number) - (a as number)).map(([model, count]) => {
                    const maxCount = Math.max(...Object.values(modelUsage) as number[]);
                    return (
                      <div key={model}>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                          <span className="text-sm font-mono" style={{color: C.muted}}>{model}</span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{color: C.dim}}>{count as number}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"}}>
                          <div className="h-full rounded-full" style={{width: ((count as number) / maxCount) * 100 + "%", background: gradient}} />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <footer className="relative z-10 py-8 mt-12" style={{borderTop: "1px solid " + C.border}}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider" style={{color: C.dim}}>2026 Zenlyte</p>
                <a href="https://zo.computer" target="_blank" rel="noopener" className="text-xs transition-colors hover:text-white" style={{color: C.dim}}>Built on <span style={{color: C.cyan}}>Zo</span></a>
              </div>
            </footer>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `/temporal` (page, private)

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";

const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f",
  card: "#0f1117",
  cyan: "#06b6d4",
  cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1",
  indigoLight: "#818cf8",
  muted: "#94a3b8",
  dimmed: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
};

function GlobalNav() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [auth, setAuth] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { setLinks(d.links || []); setAuth(d.authenticated); })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const onClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      {/* Desktop: Top-right navigation */}
      <div className="hidden md:block absolute top-6 right-6 z-50" ref={ref}>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          className="bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 text-white p-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-xl hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
          style={{ borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" }}
        >
          <span style={{ color: "#06b6d4", fontSize: "20px" }}>☰</span>
        </button>
        
        {open && (
          <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-2 w-64 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
            style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.98)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" }}>
            {auth && (
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-cyan-400 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Authenticated</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              {links.map((l, idx) => (
                <a key={l.path} href={l.path} 
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider w-6 text-cyan-400">
                    {String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  <span>{l.name}</span>
                  {l.category === "private" && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">Private</span>
                  )}
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Mobile: Floating FAB at bottom-right */}
      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[9999]" ref={ref}>
        {open && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-16 right-0 mb-2 w-64 rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden" 
               style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" }}>
            {auth && (
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-cyan-400 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Authenticated</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto py-2">
              {links.map((l, idx) => (
                <a key={l.path} href={l.path}
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider w-6 text-cyan-400">
                    {String(idx + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  <span>{l.name}</span>
                  {l.category === "private" && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">Private</span>
                  )}
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <button 
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} 
          className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-cyan-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform"
          style={{ boxShadow: "0 4px 20px -5px rgba(6,182,212,0.6)" }}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: '24px' }}>{open ? "×" : "☰"}</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { 
  Trophy, Calendar, Shuffle, ChevronLeft, CheckCircle, XCircle, 
  BarChart3, ArrowRight, Sparkles, Loader2, Clock, ExternalLink, Lock, Menu, X, LayoutDashboard, Palette, Settings, Share2, Briefcase, PenLine
} from "lucide-react";

const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f",
  card: "#0f1117",
  cardHover: "#141420",
  cyan: "#06b6d4",
  cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1",
  indigoLight: "#818cf8",
  muted: "#94a3b8",
  dimmed: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
  borderHover: "rgba(6,182,212,0.4)",
  green: "#22c55e",
  red: "#ef4444",
};

const CACHE_VERSION = "v3-2026-03-28";
```
