```tsx
};

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { 
      headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, 
      credentials: "include" 
    })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { 
        setNavLinks(d.links || []); 
        setNavAuth(d.authenticated); 
      })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch("/api/auth-status", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setNavAuth(d.authenticated))
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    };
  }, []);

  const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
    "pencil": PenLine,
    "palette": Palette,
    "settings": Settings,
    "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard,
    "sparkles": Sparkles,
    "share-2": Share2,
    "clock": Clock,
    "briefcase": Briefcase,
  };

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);

  const COLORS = {
    cyan: "#06b6d4",
    cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
    indigo: "#6366f1",
    indigoLight: "#818cf8",
    muted: "#94a3b8",
    dimmed: "#64748b",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="hidden md:block fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999]" ref={navRef}>
        <div className="relative">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-colors border"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}
          >
            {navOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />}
          </button>
          
          {navOpen && (
            <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-3 min-w-[250px] w-max max-w-md rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
              style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              {navAuth && (
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Authenticated view</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="py-2 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                  const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                  return (
                    <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                      onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 group">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                        style={{
                          background: link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}15` : `${COLORS.cyan}15`,
                          border: `1px solid ${link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}30` : `${COLORS.cyan}30`}`,
                        }}>
                        <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">{link.name}</span>
                          {link.category === "private" && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider"
                              style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>
                              Private
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs mt-0.5 truncate" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{link.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[9999]">
        {navOpen && (
          <div
            className="absolute bottom-16 right-0 mb-2 min-w-[200px] w-max max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
            style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.98)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}
          >
            {navAuth && (
              <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Authenticated</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono tracking-widest uppercase" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
                Pages
              </div>
              {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                return (
                  <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                    onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                    <div className="w-6 flex justify-center shrink-0">
                      <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                    </div>
                    <span className="truncate">{link.name}</span>
                    {link.category === "private" && (
                      <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono"
                        style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>
                        Private
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </a>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <button
          onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
          className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
          style={{ background: COLORS.cyan, color: "white", boxShadow: `0 4px 20px -5px ${COLORS.cyan}60` }}
        >
          {navOpen ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-6 h-6" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default function TriviaQuiz() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<QuizMode>("menu");
  const [dates, setDates] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [datesDebug, setDatesDebug] = useState<string>("");
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState<any>({});
  const [leaderboardPeriod, setLeaderboardPeriod] = useState<"today"|"week"|"month"|"alltime">("today");
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[]>([]);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<{index: number, correct: boolean}[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showExplanation, setShowExplanation] = useState(false);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<{total: number, correct: number}>({total: 0, correct: 0});

  const [dailyQ, setDailyQ] = useState<{play_date:string,question:string,options:string[]} | null>(null);
  const [dailySelected, setDailySelected] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [dailyResult, setDailyResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [dailySubmitting, setDailySubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [dailyLoading, setDailyLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userStreak, setUserStreak] = useState(0);
  const [alreadyAnswered, setAlreadyAnswered] = useState(false);
  
  const [userHandle, setUserHandle] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>("");
  const [emailSubmitting, setEmailSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [emailSubmitted, setEmailSubmitted] = useState(false);

  const handleDailySelect = async (idx: number) => {
    if (dailyResult || dailySubmitting) return;
    setDailySelected(idx);
    setDailySubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/trivia", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
        credentials: "include",
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          play_date: dailyQ?.play_date, 
          selected_index: idx,
          user_handle: "curtastrophe"
        })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Failed");
      setDailyResult(data);
      setAlreadyAnswered(true);
      if (data.user_streak) setUserStreak(data.user_streak);
      if (data.is_correct) triggerConfetti();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message);
      setDailySelected(null);
    } finally {
      setDailySubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const nowTs = Date.now();
    fetch("/api/trivia/dates", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        const today = getTodayMST();
        const past = (d.dates || []).filter((dt: string) => dt <= today);
        setDates(past);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    fetch("/api/trivia/leaderboard", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => setLeaderboard(d))
      .catch(() => {});

    fetch("/api/trivia", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        if (!d.error) {
          setDailyQ(d);
          if (d.user_streak) setUserStreak(d.user_streak);
          if (d.already_answered && d.previous_answer) {
            setAlreadyAnswered(true);
            setDailySelected(d.previous_answer.selected_index);
            setDailyResult({
              is_correct: d.previous_answer.is_correct,
              correct_index: d.previous_answer.correct_index,
              explanation: d.previous_answer.explanation,
              stats: null,
            });
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setDailyLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const startRandomQuiz = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/trivia/random?count=10", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.questions && data.questions.length > 0) {
        setQuestions(data.questions);
        setCurrentIndex(0);
        setAnswers([]);
        setSelectedOption(null);
        setShowExplanation(false);
        setMode("playing");
      } else {
        alert("No questions available yet. Check back soon!");
        setLoading(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Failed to load questions");
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const startDateQuiz = async (date: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/trivia/by-date?date=${date}`, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.question) {
        setQuestions([data]);
        setCurrentIndex(0);
        setMode("playing");
      } else {
        alert(`No trivia question for ${date}. This date doesn't have a question yet!`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Failed to load question");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const submitAnswer = (optionIndex: number) => {
    if (selectedOption !== null) return;
    
    const currentQ = questions[currentIndex];
    const isCorrect = optionIndex === currentQ.correct_index;
    
    setSelectedOption(optionIndex);
    setAnswers([...answers, { index: optionIndex, correct: isCorrect }]);
    setShowExplanation(true);
  };

  const nextQuestion = () => {
    if (currentIndex < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setShowExplanation(false);
    } else {
      const correctCount = answers.filter(a => a.correct).length;
      setStats({ total: questions.length, correct: correctCount });
      setMode("results");
    }
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setMode("menu");
    setQuestions([]);
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setAnswers([]);
    setShowExplanation(false);
  };

  const triggerConfetti = () => {
    const colors = ['#06b6d4', '#6366f1', '#22d3ee', '#818cf8', '#4ade80', '#f472b6'];
    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      const particle = document.createElement('div');
      particle.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed;
        width: ${Math.random() * 8 + 4}px;
        height: ${Math.random() * 4 + 4}px;
        background: ${colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)]};
        left: 50%;
        top: 50%;
        border-radius: 2px;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 9999;
      `;
      document.body.appendChild(particle);
      
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const velocity = Math.random() * 400 + 200;
      let posX = window.innerWidth / 2;
      let posY = window.innerHeight / 2;
      let opacity = 1;
      
      const animate = () => {
        posX += Math.cos(angle) * velocity * 0.016;
        posY += Math.sin(angle) * velocity * 0.016 + 5;
        opacity -= 0.01;
        particle.style.left = posX + 'px';
        particle.style.top = posY + 'px';
        particle.style.opacity = opacity.toString();
        
        if (opacity > 0) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        else particle.remove();
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
  };

  const handleEmailSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (emailSubmitting) return;
    setEmailSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/trivia/subscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Failed");
      setEmailSubmitted(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message);
    } finally {
      setEmailSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderMenu = () => (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
          <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
          <h3 className="font-heading font-semibold text-lg">Today's Daily Question</h3>
          {alreadyAnswered && (
            <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-mono px-2 py-1 rounded-md"
              style={{ background: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)", color: COLORS.green, border: "1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.3)" }}>
              <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Completed
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {userStreak > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 text-sm font-mono px-3 py-2 rounded-lg"
            style={{ background: "rgba(251,146,60,0.1)", border: "1px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.25)", color: "#fb923c" }}>
            🔥 Streak: {userStreak} {userStreak === 1 ? "day" : "days"}
          </div>
        )}
        {dailyLoading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8 text-sm font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
            <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mr-2" /> Loading...
          </div>
        ) : dailyQ ? (
          <div className="p-5 rounded-xl" style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}08`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}25` }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
              <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
              {dailyQ.play_date}
            </div>
            <p className="font-medium leading-relaxed mb-4">{dailyQ.question}</p>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {dailyQ.options.map((opt, i) => {
                const isSelected = dailySelected === i;
                const isCorrectAns = dailyResult && dailyResult.correct_index === i;
                const isWrongSel = dailyResult && isSelected && !dailyResult.is_correct;
                let btnStyle = { background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)", borderColor: COLORS.border, color: "white" };
                if (dailyResult) {
                  if (isCorrectAns) btnStyle = { background: "rgba(34,197,94,0.15)", borderColor: COLORS.green, color: COLORS.green };
                  else if (isWrongSel) btnStyle = { background: "rgba(239,68,68,0.15)", borderColor: COLORS.red, color: COLORS.red };
                  else btnStyle = { background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.01)", borderColor: "transparent", color: COLORS.dimmed };
                } else if (isSelected) {
                  btnStyle = { background: `${COLORS.cyan}20`, borderColor: COLORS.cyan, color: COLORS.cyanLight };
                }
                return (
                  <button key={i} onClick={() => handleDailySelect(i)} disabled={!!dailyResult || dailySubmitting}
                    className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm transition-all ${(dailyResult || dailySubmitting) ? "cursor-default" : "hover:bg-white/5"}`}
                    style={{ border: "1px solid", ...btnStyle }}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs opacity-50">{String.fromCharCode(65+i)}.</span>
                      <span>{opt}</span>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            {dailyResult && (
              <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-lg" style={{ background: dailyResult.is_correct ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)" : "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)", border: `1px solid ${dailyResult.is_correct ? "#22c55e20" : "#ef444420"}` }}>
                <p className="font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: dailyResult.is_correct ? COLORS.green : COLORS.red }}>
                  {dailyResult.is_correct ? "Correct! 🎉" : "Not quite!"}
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>{dailyResult.explanation}</p>
                {dailyResult.stats && (
                  <div className="mt-3 pt-3" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${dailyResult.is_correct ? "#22c55e20" : "#ef444420"}` }}>
                    <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>{dailyResult.stats.rank_phrase}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{dailyResult.stats.correct_count} / {dailyResult.stats.total_players} answered correctly</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>No question available today.</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
          <Trophy className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
          <h3 className="font-heading font-semibold text-lg">Leaderboard</h3>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 p-1 rounded-lg" style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
          {([["today","Today"],["week","This Week"],["month","This Month"],["alltime","All Time"]] as const).map(([key, label]) => (
            <button key={key} onClick={() => setLeaderboardPeriod(key)}
              className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-md text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-all"
              style={{
                background: leaderboardPeriod === key ? `${COLORS.cyan}20` : "transparent",
                color: leaderboardPeriod === key ? COLORS.cyanLight : COLORS.dimmed,
                border: leaderboardPeriod === key ? `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}40` : `1px solid transparent`,
              }}>
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
          {(leaderboard[leaderboardPeriod] || []).length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-6 text-center">
              <p className="text-sm mb-2" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>No scores yet this period.</p>
              <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Be the first to play!</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="p-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
                <span style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Rank</span>
                <span style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Player</span>
                <span style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }} className="text-right">Score</span>
              </div>
              {(leaderboard[leaderboardPeriod] || []).slice(0, 5).map((entry: any, idx: number) => (
                <div key={`${leaderboardPeriod}-${entry.user_handle}`} className="p-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-center text-sm"
                  style={{ borderBottom: idx < Math.min((leaderboard[leaderboardPeriod] || []).length, 5) - 1 ? `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` : 'none' }}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {idx === 0 && <span className="text-base">🥇</span>}
                    {idx === 1 && <span className="text-base">🥈</span>}
                    {idx === 2 && <span className="text-base">🥉</span>}
                    {idx > 2 && <span style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>#{idx + 1}</span>}
                    {entry.user_handle
                      ? <span className="font-medium truncate max-w-[80px]">{entry.user_handle}</span>
                      : <span style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>—</span>
                    }
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{entry.total_correct ?? entry.score ?? 0} correct</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-right font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>{entry.score ?? 0}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <button onClick={() => setMode("random")} disabled={loading}
          className="p-5 rounded-xl text-left card-hover transition-all"
          style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-3"
            style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}30` }}>
            <Shuffle className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-semibold mb-1">Random Quiz</h3>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>10 random past questions</p>
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => setMode("calendar")}
          className="p-5 rounded-xl text-left card-hover transition-all"
          style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-3"
            style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.indigo}30` }}>
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.indigo }} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-semibold mb-1">Browse by Date</h3>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Pick any past question</p>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="text-center">
        <a href="/" className="text-sm font-mono tracking-wider" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>
          ← Back to Homepage
        </a>
      </div>

      {/* Email Signup */}
      <div className="rounded-xl p-5" style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}08`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.indigo}25` }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: COLORS.indigo }} />
          <h3 className="font-heading font-semibold text-sm">Get Tomorrow's Question</h3>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs mb-4" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>
          Subscribe and we'll email you tomorrow's Zo Computer trivia question before it goes live.
        </p>
        <form onSubmit={handleEmailSubmit} className="flex gap-2">
          <input
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            required
            className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm"
            style={{ 
              background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", 
              border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`,
              color: "white",
              outline: "none"
            }}
          />
          <button 
            type="submit" 
            disabled={emailSubmitting}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all hover:opacity-90"
            style={{ background: COLORS.indigo, color: "white" }}
          >
            {emailSubmitting ? "..." : emailSubmitted ? "✓ Subscribed" : "Notify Me"}
          </button>
        </form>
        {emailSubmitted && (
          <p className="text-xs mt-2" style={{ color: COLORS.green }}>You're signed up! Check your inbox tomorrow.</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const renderCalendar = () => {
    const today = getTodayMST();
    const availableDates = dates.filter(d => d <= today);
    const byMonth: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    availableDates.forEach(d => {
      const month = d.slice(0, 7);
      if (!byMonth[month]) byMonth[month] = [];
      byMonth[month].push(d);
    });

    const monthNames = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
    
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
          <button onClick={() => setMode("menu")} className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5">
            <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <h3 className="font-heading text-xl font-semibold">Select a Date</h3>
        </div>
        
        {Object.entries(byMonth).length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-8">
            <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>No past questions available yet.</p>
            <p className="text-xs mt-2" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Check back soon!</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          Object.entries(byMonth).map(([month, monthDates]) => {
            const [y, m] = month.split("-");
            const monthLabel = `${monthNames[parseInt(m, 10) - 1]} ${y}`;
            return (
            <div key={month} className="mb-6">
              <h4 className="font-mono text-xs tracking-wider uppercase mb-3" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
                {monthLabel}
              </h4>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2">
                {monthDates.map(date => {
                  const dayNum = parseInt(date.split("-")[2], 10);
                  return (
                  <button
                    key={date}
                    onClick={() => startDateQuiz(date)}
                    disabled={loading}
                    className="p-3 rounded-lg text-center text-sm transition-all hover:bg-white/5"
                    style={{ 
                      background: COLORS.card, 
                      border: `1px solid ${date === today ? COLORS.cyan + '60' : COLORS.border}`,
                      color: date === today ? COLORS.cyanLight : 'white'
                    }}
                  >
                    <div className="font-mono text-xs" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
                      {dayNum}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderPlaying = () => {
    if (questions.length === 0) return null;
    const q = questions[currentIndex];
    const isAnswered = selectedOption !== null;
    const isCorrect = isAnswered && selectedOption === q.correct_index;
    
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
            Question {currentIndex + 1} of {questions.length}
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>
            {answers.filter(a => a.correct).length} / {answers.length} correct
          </span>
        </div>
        
        {q.play_date && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
            Originally from {q.play_date}
          </div>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => { setMode("menu"); setQuestions([]); setCurrentIndex(0); setSelectedOption(null); setShowExplanation(false); }}
          className="text-xs font-mono mb-4 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all hover:bg-white/5"
          style={{ border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.dimmed }}
        >
          ← Return to Quiz
        </button>
        
        <p className="font-medium leading-relaxed text-lg mb-6">{q.question}</p>
        
        <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
          {q.options.map((opt, i) => {
            const isSelected = selectedOption === i;
            const isCorrectAns = q.correct_index === i;
            
            let btnStyle = { 
              background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)", 
              borderColor: COLORS.border,
              color: "white"
            };
            
            if (isAnswered) {
              if (isCorrectAns) {
                btnStyle = { background: `rgba(34,197,94,0.15)`, borderColor: COLORS.green, color: COLORS.green };
              } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectAns) {
                btnStyle = { background: `rgba(239,68,68,0.15)`, borderColor: COLORS.red, color: COLORS.red };
              } else {
                btnStyle = { background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.01)", borderColor: "transparent", color: COLORS.dimmed };
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              btnStyle = { background: `${COLORS.cyan}20`, borderColor: COLORS.cyan, color: COLORS.cyanLight };
            }

            return (
              <button 
                key={i}
                onClick={() => submitAnswer(i)}
                disabled={isAnswered}
                className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-4 rounded-lg transition-all ${isAnswered ? 'cursor-default' : 'hover:bg-white/5'}`}
                style={{ border: "1px solid", ...btnStyle }}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm">{String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}.</span>
                  <span>{opt}</span>
                  {isAnswered && isCorrectAns && <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 ml-auto" />}
                  {isAnswered && isSelected && !isCorrectAns && <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 ml-auto" />}
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        {showExplanation && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg mb-6" 
            style={{ background: isCorrect ? `rgba(34,197,94,0.1)` : `rgba(239,68,68,0.1)`, border: `1px solid ${isCorrect ? '#22c55e30' : '#ef444430'}` }}>
            <p className="font-semibold mb-2" style={{ color: isCorrect ? COLORS.green : COLORS.red }}>
              {isCorrect ? "Correct! 🎉" : "Incorrect"}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>{q.explanation}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {isAnswered && (
          <button 
            onClick={nextQuestion}
            className="w-full py-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]"
            style={{ 
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${COLORS.cyan}, ${COLORS.indigo})`,
              color: 'white'
            }}
          >
            {currentIndex < questions.length - 1 ? "Next Question →" : "See Results"}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderResults = () => {
    const percentage = Math.round((stats.correct / stats.total) * 100);
    let message = "";
    if (percentage >= 90) message = "🎉 Zo Computer Expert!";
    else if (percentage >= 70) message = "👍 Great job!";
    else if (percentage >= 50) message = "💪 Keep learning!";
    else message = "📚 Study up and try again!";
    
    if (percentage >= 70) triggerConfetti();
    
    return (
      <div className="text-center">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full mx-auto mb-6 flex items-center justify-center"
          style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}15`, border: `2px solid ${COLORS.cyan}40` }}>
          <Trophy className="w-10 h-10" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
        </div>
        
        <h2 className="font-heading text-3xl font-bold mb-2">Quiz Complete!</h2>
        <p className="text-lg mb-6" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>{message}</p>
        
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8">
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>{stats.correct}</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Correct</p>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.indigo }}>{stats.total - stats.correct}</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Incorrect</p>
          </div>
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.green }}>{percentage}%</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Score</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <button 
            onClick={reset}
            className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]"
            style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${COLORS.cyan}, ${COLORS.indigo})`, color: 'white' }}
          >
            Play Again
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={reset}
            className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase text-center transition-all hover:bg-white/5"
            style={{ border: `2px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.muted }}
          >
            Back to Quiz
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        .font-heading { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
        .font-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        .font-mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
        .card-hover { transition: all 0.3s ease; }
        .card-hover:hover { border-color: rgba(6,182,212,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 30px -10px rgba(6,182,212,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); }
      `}</style>
      
      <div className="min-h-screen text-white font-body p-4 md:p-8" style={{ background: COLORS.bg }}>
        <GlobalNav />
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          <div className="p-6 md:p-8 rounded-2xl" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            {mode === "menu" && renderMenu()}
            {mode === "random" && renderMenu()}
            {mode === "calendar" && renderCalendar()}
            {mode === "playing" && renderPlaying()}
            {mode === "results" && renderResults()}
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {loading && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 z-50">
            <div className="p-6 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
              <span>Loading...</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### `/trivia/archive` (page, private)

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { 
  Calendar, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Clock, 
  Search, ArrowRight, Sparkles, Loader2, Menu, X, 
  Lock, LayoutDashboard, Palette, Settings, Share2, 
  Briefcase, PenLine, ExternalLink
} from "lucide-react";

const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f",
  card: "#0f1117",
  cardHover: "#141420",
  cyan: "#06b6d4",
  cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1",
  indigoLight: "#818cf8",
  muted: "#94a3b8",
  dimmed: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
  borderHover: "rgba(6,182,212,0.4)",
};

const getTodayMST = () => {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/Edmonton" });
};

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { 
        setNavLinks(d.links || []); 
        setNavAuth(d.authenticated); 
      })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch("/api/auth-status", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setNavAuth(d.authenticated))
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    };
  }, []);

  const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
    "pencil": PenLine,
    "palette": Palette,
    "settings": Settings,
    "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard,
    "sparkles": Sparkles,
    "share-2": Share2,
    "clock": Clock,
    "briefcase": Briefcase,
  };

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);

  return (
    <>

                return (
                  <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                    onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                    <div className="w-6 flex justify-center shrink-0">
                      <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                    </div>

        >

      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default function TriviaArchive() {
  const [dates, setDates] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const today = getTodayMST();
    fetch("/api/trivia/dates", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        const available = (d.dates || []).filter((dt: string) => dt <= today).reverse();
        setDates(available);
      })
      .catch(console.error)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filteredDates = search 
    ? dates.filter(d => d.includes(search))
    : dates;

  const groupedByMonth: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  filteredDates.forEach(date => {
    const month = date.slice(0, 7);
    if (!groupedByMonth[month]) groupedByMonth[month] = [];
    groupedByMonth[month].push(date);
  });

  const monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        .font-heading { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
        .font-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        .font-mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
        .card-hover { transition: all 0.3s ease; }
        .card-hover:hover { border-color: rgba(6,182,212,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 30px -10px rgba(6,182,212,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); }
      `}</style>

      <div className="min-h-screen text-white font-body p-6 md:p-12 relative overflow-hidden" style={{ background: COLORS.bg }}>
        {/* Background grid */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-grid opacity-20 pointer-events-none" style={{
          backgroundSize: "60px 60px",
          backgroundImage: "linear-gradient(to right, rgba(99,102,241,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6,182,212,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px)"
        }} />
        
        <GlobalNav />

        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto relative z-10">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6 mb-12">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}30` }}>
                  <Calendar className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
                </div>
                <h1 className="font-heading text-3xl font-bold">Trivia Archive</h1>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Browse and play all past Zo Computer trivia questions.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }} />
              <input 
                type="text" 
                placeholder="Search dates (YYYY-MM)..."
                value={search}
                onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white/5 border outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 transition-colors w-full md:w-64"
                style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-4">
              <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 animate-spin" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
              <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Initializing archive...</p>
            </div>
          ) : Object.keys(groupedByMonth).length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-20 rounded-2xl border border-dashed" style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
              <Clock className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-20" />
              <p style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>No questions found matching your search.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-12">
              {Object.entries(groupedByMonth).map(([month, monthDates]) => {
                const [y, m] = month.split("-");
                const monthLabel = `${monthNames[parseInt(m, 10) - 1]} ${y}`;
                
                return (
                  <div key={month} className="animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500">
                    <h2 className="font-heading text-xl font-semibold mb-6 flex items-center gap-4">
                      {monthLabel}
                      <div className="h-px flex-1" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${COLORS.border}, transparent)` }} />
                    </h2>
                    
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                      {monthDates.map(date => {
                        const d = new Date(date + "T00:00:00");
                        const dayName = d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "long" });
                        const dayNum = parseInt(date.split("-")[2], 10);
                        const isToday = date === getTodayMST();

                        return (
                          <a 
                            key={date} 
                            href={`/trivia?date=${date}`}
                            className="group p-5 rounded-xl border card-hover bg-[#0f1117]/50 backdrop-blur-sm relative overflow-hidden"
                            style={{ borderColor: isToday ? `${COLORS.cyan}40` : COLORS.border }}
                          >
                            {isToday && (
                              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider bg-cyan-500 text-black font-bold">
                                Today
                              </div>
                            )}
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                              <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{dayName}</span>
                              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-cyan-500/10 transition-colors">
                                <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" style={{ color: isToday ? COLORS.cyan : COLORS.dimmed }} />
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                              <span className="text-3xl font-bold font-heading">{dayNum}</span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{monthLabel}</span>
                            </div>
                          </a>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-20 pt-8 border-t text-center" style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
            <a href="/trivia" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-mono tracking-widest uppercase transition-colors hover:text-cyan-400" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to Quiz
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### `/trivia/leaderboard` (page, private)

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { 
  Trophy, Medal, Users, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, 
  Sparkles, Loader2, Menu, X, Lock, LayoutDashboard, 
  Palette, Settings, Share2, Briefcase, PenLine, 
  ExternalLink, Clock, TrendingUp, Calendar
} from "lucide-react";

const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f",
  card: "#0f1117",
  cardHover: "#141420",
  cyan: "#06b6d4",
  cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1",
  indigoLight: "#818cf8",
  muted: "#94a3b8",
  dimmed: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
  borderHover: "rgba(6,182,212,0.4)",
  gold: "#fbbf24",
  silver: "#94a3b8",
  bronze: "#b45309",
};

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { 
        setNavLinks(d.links || []); 
        setNavAuth(d.authenticated); 
      })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch("/api/auth-status", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setNavAuth(d.authenticated))
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    };
  }, []);

  const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
    "pencil": PenLine,
    "palette": Palette,
    "settings": Settings,
    "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard,
    "sparkles": Sparkles,
    "share-2": Share2,
    "clock": Clock,
    "briefcase": Briefcase,
  };

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="hidden md:block fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999]" ref={navRef}>
        <div className="relative">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-colors border"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}
          >
            {navOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />}
          </button>
          
          {navOpen && (
            <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-3 min-w-[250px] w-max max-w-md rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
              style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              {navAuth && (
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Authenticated view</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="py-2 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                  const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                  return (
                    <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                      onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 group">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                        style={{
                          background: link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}15` : `${COLORS.cyan}15`,
                          border: `1px solid ${link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}30` : `${COLORS.cyan}30`}`,
                        }}>
                        <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">{link.name}</span>
                          {link.category === "private" && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider"
                              style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>
                              Private
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs mt-0.5 truncate" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{link.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[9999]">
        {navOpen && (
          <div
            className="absolute bottom-16 right-0 mb-2 min-w-[200px] w-max max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
            style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.98)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}
          >
            {navAuth && (
              <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Authenticated</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono tracking-widest uppercase" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
                Pages
              </div>
              {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                return (
                  <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                    onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                    <div className="w-6 flex justify-center shrink-0">
                      <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                    </div>
                    <span className="truncate">{link.name}</span>
                    {link.category === "private" && (
                      <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono"
                        style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>
                        Private
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </a>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <button
          onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
          className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
          style={{ background: COLORS.cyan, color: "white", boxShadow: `0 4px 20px -5px ${COLORS.cyan}60` }}
        >
          {navOpen ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-6 h-6" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default function TriviaLeaderboard() {
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState<any>({});
  const [userStats, setUserStats] = useState<any>(null);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<"today" | "week" | "month" | "alltime">("today");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [lbRes, statsRes] = await Promise.all([
          fetch("/api/trivia/leaderboard", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }),
          fetch("/api/trivia/user-stats", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        ]);
        
        const lbData = await lbRes.json();
        const statsData = await statsRes.json();
        
        setLeaderboard(lbData);
        if (!statsData.error) setUserStats(statsData);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch leaderboard data", e);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const entries = leaderboard[period] || [];

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        .font-heading { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
        .font-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        .font-mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
        .card-hover { transition: all 0.3s ease; }
        .card-hover:hover { border-color: rgba(6,182,212,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 30px -10px rgba(6,182,212,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); }
      `}</style>

      <div className="min-h-screen text-white font-body p-6 md:p-12 relative overflow-hidden" style={{ background: COLORS.bg }}>
        {/* Background grid */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-grid opacity-20 pointer-events-none" style={{
          backgroundSize: "60px 60px",
          backgroundImage: "linear-gradient(to right, rgba(99,102,241,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(6,182,212,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px)"
        }} />
        
        <GlobalNav />

        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto relative z-10">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-8 mb-12">
            <div className="text-center md:text-left">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center md:justify-start gap-3 mb-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}30` }}>
                  <Trophy className="w-6 h-6" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
                </div>
                <h1 className="font-heading text-4xl font-bold">Hall of Fame</h1>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Recognizing the top minds in the Zo Computer community.</p>
            </div>

            {userStats && (
              <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl border flex items-center gap-6" style={{ background: COLORS.card, borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest mb-1" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Streak</p>\
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold font-heading" style={{ color: "#fb923c" }}>🔥 {userStats.best_streak || 0}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="w-px h-10 bg-white/10" />
                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest mb-1" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Accuracy</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold font-heading" style={{ color: COLORS.cyanLight }}>{userStats.accuracy || 0}%</p>
                </div>
                <div className="w-px h-10 bg-white/10" />
                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest mb-1" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Correct</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold font-heading" style={{ color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>{userStats.total_correct || 0}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center md:justify-start gap-2 mb-8 p-1 rounded-xl w-max mx-auto md:mx-0" style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.03)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            {([["today", "Today"], ["week", "This Week"], ["month", "This Month"], ["alltime", "All Time"]] as const).map(([key, label]) => (
              <button key={key} onClick={() => setPeriod(key)}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-widest uppercase transition-all duration-300"
                style={{
                  background: period === key ? `linear-gradient(135deg, ${COLORS.cyan}, ${COLORS.indigo})` : "transparent",
                  color: period === key ? "white" : COLORS.dimmed,
                  boxShadow: period === key ? `0 4px 15px -5px ${COLORS.cyan}60` : "none",
                }}>
                {label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border overflow-hidden" style={{ background: COLORS.card, borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-32 gap-4">
                <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 animate-spin" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
                <p className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Retrieving rankings...</p>
              </div>
            ) : entries.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-32">
                <Users className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-20" />
                <p style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>No rankings available for this period yet.</p>
                <a href="/trivia" className="mt-4 inline-block text-sm font-mono text-cyan-400 hover:underline">Be the first to play!</a>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-12 px-8 py-4 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
                  <div className="col-span-2">Rank</div>
                  <div className="col-span-6">Player</div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 text-right">Correct</div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 text-right">Score</div>
                </div>
                {entries.map((entry: any, idx: number) => {
                  const isTop3 = idx < 3;
                  const rankColor = idx === 0 ? COLORS.gold : idx === 1 ? COLORS.silver : idx === 2 ? COLORS.bronze : COLORS.dimmed;
                  const isUser = entry.user_handle === "curtastrophe";

                  return (
                    <div key={`${period}-${entry.user_handle}-${idx}`} 
                      className={`grid grid-cols-12 px-8 py-6 items-center transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.02] ${isUser ? "bg-cyan-500/[0.03]" : ""}`}>
                      <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-3">
                        {idx === 0 && <Medal className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.gold }} />}
                        {idx === 1 && <Medal className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.silver }} />}
                        {idx === 2 && <Medal className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.bronze }} />}
                        {idx > 2 && <span className="font-mono font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>#{idx + 1}</span>}
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-6 flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm" 
                          style={{ background: isUser ? COLORS.cyan : "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", border: `1px solid ${isUser ? COLORS.cyanLight : COLORS.border}` }}>
                          {entry.user_handle?.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || "?"}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-heading font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                            {entry.user_handle || "Anonymous"}
                            {isUser && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-mono bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 uppercase tracking-tighter">You</span>}
                          </p>
                          {entry.streak > 1 && <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-orange-400">🔥 {entry.streak} day streak</p>}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 text-right font-mono text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>
                        {entry.total_correct || entry.score || 0}
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 text-right font-heading font-bold text-lg" style={{ color: isTop3 ? rankColor : COLORS.cyanLight }}>
                        {entry.score || 0}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-12 grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <a href="/trivia" className="p-6 rounded-2xl border card-hover flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3" style={{ background: COLORS.card, borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.cyan}30` }}>
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-bold text-sm">Play Daily Trivia</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Climb the rankings with today\'s question.</p>
            </a>
            <a href="/trivia/archive" className="p-6 rounded-2xl border card-hover flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3" style={{ background: COLORS.card, borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}15`, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.indigo}30` }}>
                <Calendar className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.indigo }} />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-bold text-sm">View Archive</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Browse past questions and stats.</p>\
            </a>
            <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3" style={{ background: COLORS.card, borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
                <Users className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }} />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-bold text-sm">Refer a Friend</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Earn rewards when friends join Zo.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-20 pt-8 border-t text-center" style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}>
            <a href="/" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-mono tracking-widest uppercase transition-colors hover:text-cyan-400" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Back to Homepage
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```
