### `/zo-city` (page, public)

```tsx
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";

const TW = 16, TH = 8;
const GW = 21, GH = 10.5;

function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed;
  return () => { s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647; return s / 2147483647; };
}

function shade(hex: string, f: number): string {
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return `rgb(${Math.min(255, Math.round(((n >> 16) & 0xff) * f))},${Math.min(255, Math.round(((n >> 8) & 0xff) * f))},${Math.min(255, Math.round((n & 0xff) * f))})`;
}

interface District {
  id: string; name: string; count: number; color: string;
  label: string; sub?: string; cols: number; rows: number;
  qx?: number; qy?: number; ox: number; oy: number;
}

interface Building {
  sx: number; sy: number; h: number; color: string;
  district: string; type: number; cv: number;
  elemDate?: string; elemName?: string; elemIdx: number;
}

interface TimelineElement {
  id: string; type: string; name: string; date: string;
}

const CX = 440, CY = 180;

const FALLBACK_RAW = [
  { id: "skills", name: "Skills", count: 175, color: "#06b6d4", label: "Downtown Core", cols: 5, rows: 5, qx: 0, qy: 0 },
  { id: "routes", name: "Routes", count: 97, color: "#a855f7", label: "Space District", sub: "60 API, 37 Pages", cols: 4, rows: 4, qx: 6, qy: 1 },
  { id: "agents", name: "Agents", count: 39, color: "#f59e0b", label: "Automation Alley", sub: "26 Active", cols: 4, rows: 3, qx: 1, qy: 6 },
  { id: "services", name: "Services", count: 5, color: "#22c55e", label: "Services Row", cols: 5, rows: 1, qx: 6, qy: 6 },
  { id: "sites", name: "Sites", count: 3, color: "#ec4899", label: "Sites Square", cols: 2, rows: 2, qx: -3, qy: 1 },
  { id: "datasets", name: "Datasets", count: 3, color: "#3b82f6", label: "Data Warehouse", cols: 3, rows: 1, qx: 1, qy: 10 },
];

const FALLBACK: District[] = FALLBACK_RAW.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  ox: CX + (d.qx - d.qy) * GW,
  oy: CY + (d.qx + d.qy) * GH,
}));

// ===== CITY INFRASTRUCTURE =====
const GND = { cx: 440, cy: 285, hw: 400, hh: 225 };

const GRID_ROADS: [number, number, number, number, number, boolean][] = [
  // Main N-S (qx=5)
  [5, -3, 5, 13, 16, true],
  // Main E-W (qy=5)
  [-6, 5, 12, 5, 16, true],
  // Secondary N-S 1 (left)
  [-1, -3, -1, 13, 10, false],
  // Secondary N-S 2 (right)
  [11, -3, 11, 8, 10, false],
  // Secondary E-W 1 (top)
  [-6, -1, 12, -1, 10, false],
  // Secondary E-W 2 (bottom/mid)
  [-2, 9, 8, 9, 10, false],
  // Secondary E-W 3 (below sites)
  [-6, 3, -1, 3, 10, false]
];

// Roads: [x1, y1, x2, y2, width, isMain]
const ROADS: [number,number,number,number,number,boolean][] = GRID_ROADS.map(
  ([qx1, qy1, qx2, qy2, w, main]) => [
    CX + (qx1 - qy1) * GW,
    CY + (qx1 + qy1) * GH,
    CX + (qx2 - qy2) * GW,
    CY + (qx2 + qy2) * GH,
    w,
    main
  ]
);

function mkTrees() {
  const ts: {x:number;y:number;s:number;tp:number}[] = [];
  const r = rng(777);
  for (const [x1,y1,x2,y2,w] of ROADS) {
    const dx = x2-x1, dy = y2-y1, len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if (len < 50) continue;
    const nx = -dy/len, ny = dx/len;
    const ct = Math.floor(len / 55);
    for (let i = 0; i < ct; i++) {
      const t = (i + 0.5) / ct;
      const side = r() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
      const off = (w/2 + 8 + r() * 14) * side;
      ts.push({ x: x1+dx*t+nx*off, y: y1+dy*t+ny*off, s: 0.5+r()*0.5, tp: r()>0.55 ? 1 : 0 });
    }
  }
  const GRID_PARKS: [number, number][] = [
    [-2, -2], [2, -2], [8, -2],
    [-2, 6], [-2, 8], [6, 8],
    [8, 8], [10, 2], [10, 6],
    [3, 11], [6, 10], [-4, 2]
  ];
  const parks: [number,number][] = GRID_PARKS.map(([qx, qy]) => [
    CX + (qx - qy) * GW,
    CY + (qx + qy) * GH
  ]);
  for (const [px, py] of parks) {
    const n = 2 + Math.floor(r() * 4);
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      ts.push({ x: px+(r()-0.5)*35, y: py+(r()-0.5)*20, s: 0.4+r()*0.6, tp: r()>0.5 ? 1 : 0 });
    }
  }
  return ts.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
}
const TREES = mkTrees();

function Tree({ t }: { t: {x:number;y:number;s:number;tp:number} }) {
  const { x, y, s, tp } = t;
  if (tp === 0) {
    return (
      <g opacity={0.9}>
        <ellipse cx={x} cy={y+4*s} rx={5*s} ry={2.5*s} fill="#040a04" opacity={0.4} />
        <rect x={x-0.6*s} y={y-4*s} width={1.2*s} height={5.5*s} fill="#1c1408" />
        <ellipse cx={x} cy={y-6*s} rx={4.2*s} ry={5*s} fill="#0e3518" />
        <ellipse cx={x-0.5*s} cy={y-8.5*s} rx={3.2*s} ry={4*s} fill="#165a2a" />
      </g>
    );
  }
  return (
    <g opacity={0.9}>
      <ellipse cx={x} cy={y+4*s} rx={4*s} ry={2*s} fill="#040a04" opacity={0.4} />
      <rect x={x-0.5*s} y={y-6*s} width={1*s} height={7*s} fill="#1c1408" />
      <path d={`M${x},${y-15*s} L${x+3.5*s},${y-5*s} L${x-3.5*s},${y-5*s}Z`} fill="#0e3518" />
      <path d={`M${x},${y-18*s} L${x+2.8*s},${y-9*s} L${x-2.8*s},${y-9*s}Z`} fill="#165a2a" />
    </g>
  );
}

// ===== END INFRASTRUCTURE =====

function bType(h: number, r: number): number {
  if (h < 18) return 0;
  if (h < 30) return r < 0.55 ? 1 : 0;
  if (h < 50) return r < 0.2 ? 3 : r < 0.5 ? 4 : 1;
  return r < 0.3 ? 2 : r < 0.55 ? 4 : 1;
}

function generateCity(districts: District[], elements: TimelineElement[]): Building[] {
  const all: Building[] = [];
  const elemsByType: Record<string, TimelineElement[]> = {};
  for (const e of elements) {
    if (!elemsByType[e.type]) elemsByType[e.type] = [];
    elemsByType[e.type].push(e);
  }

  let globalIdx = 0;
  districts.forEach((d, di) => {
    const rand = rng(42 + di * 137);
    const maxH = Math.min(85, 20 + d.count * 0.4);
    const midX = (d.cols - 1) / 2, midY = (d.rows - 1) / 2;
    const maxDist = midX + midY || 1;
    const typeElems = elemsByType[d.id] || [];
    let elemI = 0;

    for (let gy = 0; gy < d.rows; gy++) {
      for (let gx = 0; gx < d.cols; gx++) {
        const cd = (Math.abs(gx - midX) + Math.abs(gy - midY)) / maxDist;
        const r1 = rand(), r2 = rand(), r3 = rand();
        const h = Math.max(8, Math.round(maxH * (0.4 + 0.6 * r1) * (1 - cd * 0.25)));
        const elem = typeElems[elemI];
        all.push({
          sx: d.ox + (gx - gy) * GW,
          sy: d.oy + (gx + gy) * GH,
          h, color: d.color, district: d.id,
          type: bType(h, r2), cv: 0.88 + r3 * 0.24,
          elemDate: elem?.date,
          elemName: elem?.name,
          elemIdx: globalIdx++,
        });
        elemI++;
      }
    }
  });
  all.sort((a, b) => a.sy - b.sy || a.sx - b.sx);
  return all;
}

function Bldg({ b, bright, scale }: { b: Building; bright: boolean; scale: number }) {
  const { sx, sy, h: rawH, color, type, cv } = b;
  const h = rawH * scale;
  if (scale <= 0) return null;

  const topC = shade(color, (bright ? 1.3 : 1.0) * cv);
  const leftC = shade(color, 0.55 * cv);
  const rightC = shade(color, 0.35 * cv);
  const els: React.ReactNode[] = [];

  els.push(
    <path key="l" d={`M${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH}L${sx-TW},${sy+TH}Z`} fill={leftC} />,
    <path key="r" d={`M${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH}L${sx+TW},${sy+TH}Z`} fill={rightC} />
  );

  if ((type === 1 || type === 4) && scale > 0.5) {
    const floors = Math.max(2, Math.floor(h / 8));
    let wd = "";
    for (let f = 1; f < floors; f++) {
      const ly = h * (f / floors);
      wd += `M${sx-TW},${sy+TH-ly}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-ly}`;
      wd += `M${sx+TW},${sy+TH-ly}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-ly}`;
    }
    const vcols = Math.max(1, Math.floor(TW / 5));
    for (let v = 1; v < vcols; v++) {
      wd += `M${sx - TW * (1 - v/vcols)},${sy + TH * (1 - v/vcols) - h}L${sx - TW * (1 - v/vcols)},${sy + TH * (1 - v/vcols)}`;
      wd += `M${sx + TW * (v/vcols)},${sy + TH * (v/vcols) - h}L${sx + TW * (v/vcols)},${sy + TH * (v/vcols)}`;
    }
    els.push(<path key="w" d={wd} stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" strokeWidth={0.4} fill="none" />);
  }

  if (type !== 2) {
    els.push(<path key="t" d={`M${sx},${sy-h}L${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}L${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}Z`} fill={topC} />);
  }

  if (type === 2) {
    const spH = 6 + h * 0.22;
    const pk = sy - h - spH;
    els.push(
      <path key="sb1" d={`M${sx},${sy-h}L${sx},${pk}L${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.8 * cv)} />,
      <path key="sb2" d={`M${sx},${sy-h}L${sx},${pk}L${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.5 * cv)} />,
      <path key="sf1" d={`M${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${pk}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.95 * cv)} />,
      <path key="sf2" d={`M${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${pk}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.6 * cv)} />
    );
  }

  if (type === 3) {
    const aH = 6 + h * 0.18;
    els.push(
      <line key="al" x1={sx} y1={sy - h} x2={sx} y2={sy - h - aH} stroke={shade(color, 0.7 * cv)} strokeWidth={1} />,
      <circle key="at" cx={sx} cy={sy - h - aH} r={1.5} fill={color} opacity={bright ? 1 : 0.5} />
    );
    if (bright) {
      els.push(<circle key="atg" cx={sx} cy={sy - h - aH} r={3} fill={color} opacity={0.3} filter="url(#glow)" />);
    }
  }

  if (type === 4) {
    const bw = TW * 0.35, bth = bw / 2, bH = 3 + h * 0.1;
    const bx = sx, by = sy + TH - h;
    els.push(
      <path key="rl" d={`M${bx-bw},${by+bth-bH}L${bx},${by+2*bth-bH}L${bx},${by+2*bth}L${bx-bw},${by+bth}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.45 * cv)} />,
      <path key="rr" d={`M${bx+bw},${by+bth-bH}L${bx},${by+2*bth-bH}L${bx},${by+2*bth}L${bx+bw},${by+bth}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.3 * cv)} />,
      <path key="rt" d={`M${bx},${by-bH}L${bx+bw},${by+bth-bH}L${bx},${by+2*bth-bH}L${bx-bw},${by+bth-bH}Z`} fill={shade(color, 0.85 * cv)} />
    );
  }

  if (bright) {
    const gPath = type === 2
      ? `M${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy-h-6-h*0.22}L${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}Z`
      : `M${sx},${sy-h}L${sx+TW},${sy+TH-h}L${sx},${sy+2*TH-h}L${sx-TW},${sy+TH-h}Z`;
    els.push(<path key="g" d={gPath} fill={color} opacity={0.15} filter="url(#glow)" />);
  }

  return <g style={{ transition: "opacity 0.3s" }}>{els}</g>;
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  const d = new Date(dateStr + "T12:00:00Z");
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}

export default function ZoCity() {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [districts, setDistricts] = useState<District[]>(FALLBACK);
  const [lastScanned, setLastScanned] = useState("");
  const [timelineData, setTimelineData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [timelineIdx, setTimelineIdx] = useState(-1);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(1);
  const animRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastTickRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/zo-city-data", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, cache: "no-cache" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data?.districts) {
          const updated = FALLBACK.map(fb => {
            const d = data.districts[fb.id];
            return d ? { ...fb, count: d.count, sub: d.sub || fb.sub, label: d.label || fb.label } : fb;
          });
          setDistricts(updated);
          if (data.lastScanned) {
            const d = new Date(data.lastScanned);
            setLastScanned(d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "America/Edmonton" }));
          }
        }
        if (data?.timeline) {
          setTimelineData(data.timeline);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const elements: TimelineElement[] = useMemo(() => (timelineData?.elements || []).filter((e: TimelineElement) => typeof e?.date === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(e.date) && e.date >= "2024-01-01"), [timelineData]);
  const days = useMemo(() => { if (elements.length === 0) return []; const dates = elements.map((e: TimelineElement) => e.date).sort(); const result: string[] = []; const cur = new Date(`${dates[0]}T00:00:00Z`); const endD = new Date(`${dates[dates.length - 1]}T00:00:00Z`); while (cur <= endD) { result.push(cur.toISOString().split("T")[0]); cur.setUTCDate(cur.getUTCDate() + 1); } return result; }, [elements]);
  const buildings = useMemo(() => generateCity(districts, elements), [districts, elements]);
  const total = districts.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);

  const currentDate = timelineIdx >= 0 && timelineIdx < days.length ? days[timelineIdx] : days[days.length - 1] || "";

  const buildingScales = useMemo(() => {
    if (timelineIdx < 0 || !currentDate) return buildings.map(() => 1);
    return buildings.map(b => {
      if (!b.elemDate) return 0;
      if (b.elemDate <= currentDate) {
        const daysSinceCreation = Math.max(0,
          (new Date(currentDate).getTime() - new Date(b.elemDate).getTime()) / 86400000
        );
        return Math.min(1, 0.3 + daysSinceCreation * 0.1);
      }
      return 0;
    });
  }, [buildings, currentDate, timelineIdx]);

  const currentCounts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!timelineData?.dailyCounts || !currentDate) return null;
    return timelineData.dailyCounts[currentDate] || null;
  }, [timelineData, currentDate]);

  const tick = useCallback((ts: number) => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const interval = Math.max(30, 150 / speed);
    if (ts - lastTickRef.current >= interval) {
      lastTickRef.current = ts;
      setTimelineIdx(prev => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        if (next >= days.length) {
          setPlaying(false);
          return days.length - 1;
        }
        return next;
      });
    }
    animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }, [playing, speed, days.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (playing) {
      animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    return () => { if (animRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current); };
  }, [playing, tick]);

  const handlePlay = () => {
    if (timelineIdx < 0 || timelineIdx >= days.length - 1) setTimelineIdx(0);
    setPlaying(true);
  };
  const handlePause = () => setPlaying(false);
  const handleReset = () => { setPlaying(false); setTimelineIdx(-1); };
  const handleSlider = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setPlaying(false);
    setTimelineIdx(parseInt(e.target.value));
  };
  const cycleSpeed = () => setSpeed(s => s >= 4 ? 1 : s * 2);

  const displayTotal = currentCounts ? currentCounts.total : total;

  // Split trees for z-ordering: behind buildings (low y) vs in front (high y)
  const treeSplitY = 290;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#07070d] text-white flex flex-col select-none">
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row flex-1 overflow-hidden">
        {/* City View */}
        <div className="flex-1 relative min-h-[50vh] lg:min-h-0">
          <div className="absolute top-5 left-6 z-10">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-[0.25em] text-cyan-400" style={{ textShadow: "0 0 30px rgba(6,182,212,0.4)" }}>ZOCITY</h1>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 tracking-[0.35em] mt-0.5 font-medium">URBAN SENTINEL</p>
          </div>
          {timelineIdx >= 0 && currentDate && (
            <div className="absolute top-5 right-6 z-10 text-right">
              <p className="text-lg font-mono font-bold text-cyan-400" style={{ textShadow: "0 0 20px rgba(6,182,212,0.3)" }}>
                {formatDate(currentDate)}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">
                Day {timelineIdx + 1} of {days.length}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <svg viewBox="20 40 880 500" className="w-full h-full" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
            <defs>
              <filter id="glow"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b" /><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b" /><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" /></feMerge></filter>
              <pattern id="dots" width="32" height="32" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="0.4" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.03)" /></pattern>
              <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#091209" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#060d06" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <rect x="20" y="40" width="880" height="500" fill="url(#dots)" />

            {/* ===== GROUND PLANE ===== */}
            <path
              d={`M${GND.cx},${GND.cy - GND.hh} L${GND.cx + GND.hw},${GND.cy} L${GND.cx},${GND.cy + GND.hh} L${GND.cx - GND.hw},${GND.cy}Z`}
              fill="url(#groundGrad)" stroke="#0f1a0f" strokeWidth={0.8}
            />
            {/* Ground grid lines (iso-aligned) */}
            {Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, i) => {
              const t = (i + 1) / 12;
              const topX = GND.cx, topY = GND.cy - GND.hh;
              const rightX = GND.cx + GND.hw, rightY = GND.cy;
              const bottomX = GND.cx, bottomY = GND.cy + GND.hh;
              const leftX = GND.cx - GND.hw, leftY = GND.cy;
              // Lines parallel to left-bottom edge
              const ax = topX + (rightX - topX) * t, ay = topY + (rightY - topY) * t;
              const bx = leftX + (bottomX - leftX) * t, by = leftY + (bottomY - leftY) * t;
              // Lines parallel to right-bottom edge
              const cx2 = topX + (leftX - topX) * t, cy2 = topY + (leftY - topY) * t;
              const dx = rightX + (bottomX - rightX) * t, dy = rightY + (bottomY - rightY) * t;
              return (
                <g key={`gg${i}`}>
                  <line x1={ax} y1={ay} x2={bx} y2={by} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.015)" strokeWidth={0.4} />
                  <line x1={cx2} y1={cy2} x2={dx} y2={dy} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.015)" strokeWidth={0.4} />
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* ===== GRASS PATCHES ===== */}
            {TREES.map((t, i) => (
              <ellipse key={`gp${i}`} cx={t.x} cy={t.y + 5 * t.s} rx={7 * t.s} ry={3.5 * t.s} fill="#071207" opacity={0.5} />
            ))}

            {/* ===== INTERNAL DISTRICT ROADS ===== */}
            {districts.map(d => {
              const districtVisible = timelineIdx < 0 || buildings.some(b => b.district === d.id && b.elemDate && b.elemDate <= currentDate);
              if (!districtVisible && timelineIdx >= 0) return null;
              
              const els = [];
              for (let gy = 0; gy <= d.rows; gy++) {
                const y_line = gy - 0.5;
                const x1 = d.ox + (-0.5 - y_line) * GW;
                const y1 = d.oy + (-0.5 + y_line) * GH;
                const x2 = d.ox + (d.cols - 0.5 - y_line) * GW;
                const y2 = d.oy + (d.cols - 0.5 + y_line) * GH;
                els.push(<line key={`r_gy_${d.id}_${gy}`} x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="#0d1115" strokeWidth={3.5} strokeLinecap="round" />);
              }
              for (let gx = 0; gx <= d.cols; gx++) {
                const x_line = gx - 0.5;
                const x1 = d.ox + (x_line - (-0.5)) * GW;
                const y1 = d.oy + (x_line + (-0.5)) * GH;
                const x2 = d.ox + (x_line - (d.rows - 0.5)) * GW;
                const y2 = d.oy + (x_line + (d.rows - 0.5)) * GH;
                els.push(<line key={`r_gx_${d.id}_${gx}`} x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="#0d1115" strokeWidth={3.5} strokeLinecap="round" />);
              }
              return <g key={`int_roads_${d.id}`} opacity={0.8}>{els}</g>;
            })}

            {/* ===== ROADS ===== */}
            {ROADS.map(([x1, y1, x2, y2, w, main], i) => (
              <g key={`rd${i}`}>
                {/* Sidewalk / road edge */}
                <line x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="#0a0a16" strokeWidth={w + 6} strokeLinecap="round" />
                {/* Road surface */}
                <line x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke={main ? "#131320" : "#101018"} strokeWidth={w} strokeLinecap="round" />
                {/* Center line marking */}
                <line x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke={main ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.1)" : "rgba(245,158,11,0.06)"} strokeWidth={main ? 1.2 : 0.8} strokeDasharray={main ? "10 7" : "6 5"} />
                {/* Edge lines (white lane markers on main roads) */}
                {main && (() => {
                  const dx = x2-x1, dy = y2-y1, len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
                  const nx = -dy/len * (w/2 - 1), ny = dx/len * (w/2 - 1);
                  return (
                    <>
                      <line x1={x1+nx} y1={y1+ny} x2={x2+nx} y2={y2+ny} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" strokeWidth={0.5} />
                      <line x1={x1-nx} y1={y1-ny} x2={x2-nx} y2={y2-ny} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" strokeWidth={0.5} />
                    </>
                  );
                })()}
              </g>
            ))}

            {/* Road intersection glow at center (qx=5, qy=5) */}
            <circle cx={CX + (5 - 5) * GW} cy={CY + (5 + 5) * GH} r={20} fill="rgba(245,158,11,0.03)" />

            {/* ===== TREES (behind buildings, y < split) ===== */}
            {TREES.filter(t => t.y < treeSplitY).map((t, i) => <Tree key={`tb${i}`} t={t} />)}

            {/* ===== BUILDINGS ===== */}
            {buildings.map((b, i) => {
              const scale = buildingScales[i];
              if (scale <= 0) return null;
              const active = !hovered || hovered === b.district;
              const bright = hovered === b.district;
              return (
                <g key={i} opacity={active ? 1 : 0.12} style={{ transition: "opacity 0.3s" }}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(b.district)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}>
                  <Bldg b={b} bright={bright} scale={scale} />
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* District labels */}
            {districts.map(d => {
              const cx = d.ox + ((d.cols - 1 - d.rows + 1) / 2) * TW;
              const districtVisible = timelineIdx < 0 || buildings.some(b => b.district === d.id && b.elemDate && b.elemDate <= currentDate);
              if (!districtVisible && timelineIdx >= 0) return null;
              return (
                <text key={d.id} x={cx} y={d.oy - 18} fill={d.color} fontSize="8" fontWeight="700"
                  textAnchor="middle" opacity={!hovered || hovered === d.id ? 0.6 : 0.08}
                  style={{ transition: "opacity 0.3s", letterSpacing: "0.15em" }}>
                  {d.name.toUpperCase()}
                </text>
              );
            })}

            {/* ===== TREES (in front of buildings, y >= split) ===== */}
            {TREES.filter(t => t.y >= treeSplitY).map((t, i) => <Tree key={`tf${i}`} t={t} />)}
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Panel */}
        <div className="w-full lg:w-72 xl:w-80 bg-[#0a0a14] border-t lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l border-white/[0.04] p-5 flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 tracking-[0.2em] font-medium">TOTAL ELEMENTS</p>
            <p className="text-4xl font-black mt-1 tabular-nums" style={{ textShadow: "0 0 20px rgba(6,182,212,0.25)" }}>{displayTotal}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 tracking-[0.2em] font-medium mb-3">DISTRICTS</p>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              {districts.map(d => {
                const count = currentCounts ? (currentCounts[d.id] ?? 0) : d.count;
                return (
                  <div key={d.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2 py-2 rounded-md cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/[0.03] transition-all"
                    style={{ opacity: hovered && hovered !== d.id ? 0.3 : 1 }}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(d.id)} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}>
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: d.color, boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${d.color}60` }} />
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold leading-tight">{d.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 leading-tight">{d.label}{d.sub ? ` · ${d.sub}` : ""}</p>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-mono font-bold shrink-0" style={{ color: d.color }}>{count}</p>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-white/[0.04] pt-4">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 tracking-[0.2em] font-medium mb-2">VIEW MODE</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
              {["Isometric", "Bird's Eye", "Street View", "Driving"].map((mode, i) => (
                <button key={mode} className={`text-[11px] py-1.5 rounded transition-colors ${i === 0 ? "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/20 font-medium" : "bg-white/[0.02] text-zinc-600 border border-white/[0.03]"}`} disabled={i > 0}>{mode}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {lastScanned && <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-700 mt-3 tracking-wide">Last scanned {lastScanned}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Bar */}
      {days.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-[#0a0a14] border-t border-white/[0.06] px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
              {playing ? (
                <button onClick={handlePause} className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-cyan-500/25 transition-colors" title="Pause">
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><rect x="2" y="1" width="3" height="10" fill="currentColor" rx="0.5" /><rect x="7" y="1" width="3" height="10" fill="currentColor" rx="0.5" /></svg>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={handlePlay} className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-cyan-500/25 transition-colors" title="Play">
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><polygon points="2,1 11,6 2,11" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
                </button>
              )}
              <button onClick={handleReset} className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] text-zinc-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors" title="Reset (show all)">
                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><rect x="1" y="1" width="4" height="10" fill="currentColor" rx="0.5" /><polygon points="6,1 11,6 6,11" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
              </button>
              <button onClick={cycleSpeed} className="h-8 px-2 rounded bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] text-zinc-500 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold hover:bg-white/[0.06] hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors" title="Playback speed">
                {speed}x
              </button>
            </div>

            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 font-mono shrink-0 hidden sm:block">
              {formatDate(days[0])}
            </span>

            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={days.length - 1}
                value={timelineIdx < 0 ? days.length - 1 : timelineIdx}
                onChange={handleSlider}
                className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full appearance-none cursor-pointer"
                style={{
                  background: `linear-gradient(to right, #06b6d4 ${((timelineIdx < 0 ? days.length - 1 : timelineIdx) / (days.length - 1)) * 100}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%)`,
                  accentColor: "#06b6d4",
                }}
              />
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-0 right-0 flex justify-between pointer-events-none">
                {days.filter((d, i) => d.endsWith("-01") || i === 0).map(d => {
                  const idx = days.indexOf(d);
                  const pct = (idx / (days.length - 1)) * 100;
                  const label = new Date(d + "T12:00:00Z").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short" });
                  return (
                    <span key={d} className="text-[8px] text-zinc-700 font-mono absolute" style={{ left: `${pct}%`, transform: "translateX(-50%)" }}>
                      {label}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 font-mono shrink-0 hidden sm:block">
              {formatDate(days[days.length - 1])}
            </span>

            <span className="text-[11px] text-cyan-400 font-mono font-bold shrink-0 sm:hidden">
              {currentDate ? formatDate(currentDate) : "Today"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
            <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-700 tracking-[0.15em]">GROWTH TIMELINE</p>
            {timelineIdx >= 0 && currentCounts && (
              <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-600 font-mono">
                {currentCounts.total} elements · {Object.entries(currentCounts).filter(([k]) => k !== "total" && (currentCounts as any)[k] > 0).map(([k, v]) => `${v} ${k}`).join(" · ")}
              </p>
            )}
            {timelineIdx < 0 && (
              <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-600 font-mono">Showing all {total} elements</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `/zo-city-three-test` (page, public)

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export default function Page() {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("loading three...");

  useEffect(() => {
    let dead = false;
    let raf = 0;
    let renderer: any;
    const load = (src: string) => new Promise<void>((ok, bad) => {
      const found = document.querySelector(`script[src="${src}"]`) as HTMLScriptElement | null;
      if (found) return ok();
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = src;
      s.async = true;
      s.onload = () => ok();
      s.onerror = () => bad(new Error("script load failed"));
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    (async () => {
      try {
        await load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js");
        const THREE = (window as any).THREE;
        if (!THREE) throw new Error("THREE missing");
        const el = ref.current;
        if (!el) throw new Error("mount missing");
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color("#020617");
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 800 / 420, 0.1, 100);
        camera.position.set(4, 4, 6);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0.6, 0);
        renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(800, 420);
        el.innerHTML = "";
        el.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
        scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.9));
        const dl = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x88ccff, 1.4);
        dl.position.set(4, 8, 3);
        scene.add(dl);
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(12, 12), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x111827 }));
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(ground);
        const road = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(7, 0.05, 1.6), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1f2937 }));
        road.position.y = 0.03;
        scene.add(road);
        const box = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x22d3ee }));
        box.position.y = 0.7;
        scene.add(box);
        const loop = () => {
          if (dead) return;
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
          box.rotation.y += 0.01;
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };
        loop();
        setStatus("ready");
      } catch (e: any) {
        setStatus(`failed: ${e?.message || "unknown"}`);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      dead = true;
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      renderer?.dispose?.();
    };
  }, []);

  return <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white p-6"><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">ZoCity Three.js Test</h1><p className="text-cyan-300 mb-4">{status}</p><div ref={ref} className="w-[800px] max-w-full min-h-[420px] border border-cyan-500/20 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40" /></div>;
}
```

### `/zo-control-deck` (page, private)

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { Activity, Server, Bot, CreditCard, Shield, AlertTriangle, FileText, Globe, Menu, X, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, ExternalLink, Lock, LayoutDashboard, Palette, Settings, Share2, Clock, Briefcase, Sparkles, PenLine } from "lucide-react";

async function getZoAgents() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch("/zo/ask", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        input: "Return a JSON object with an 'agents' key containing an array of your registered agents. Each agent needs: name (string), active (boolean), schedule (string - the rrule or schedule string). Only return the JSON object, nothing else."
      })
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    const p = JSON.parse(d.output);
    return p.agents || [];
  } catch { return []; }
}

async function getZoCredits() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch("/zo/ask", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        input: "Return a JSON object with keys: balance (number, credits), burn_7d (number), daily_burn (number), runway_days (number), reserve_usd (number). Return ONLY the JSON object, nothing else."
      })
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    return JSON.parse(d.output);
  } catch { return null; }
}

// Curtis's design system
const COLORS = {
  bg: "#0a0a0f",
  card: "#0f1117",
  cardHover: "#141420",
  cyan: "#06b6d4",
  cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
  indigo: "#6366f1",
  indigoLight: "#818cf8",
  muted: "#94a3b8",
  dimmed: "#64748b",
  border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",
  borderHover: "rgba(6,182,212,0.4)",
};

const TABS = [
  { id: "overview", label: "Overview", icon: Activity },
  { id: "services", label: "Services", icon: Server },
  { id: "agents", label: "Agents", icon: Bot },
  { id: "credits", label: "Credits", icon: CreditCard },
  { id: "spaces", label: "SPAC", icon: Globe },
  { id: "security", label: "Security", icon: Shield },
  { id: "logs", label: "Logs", icon: FileText },
  { id: "failures", label: "Failures", icon: AlertTriangle },
];

function StatusLamp({ healthy = true }: { healthy?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${healthy ? "bg-green-400" : "bg-red-400"}`} />
  );
}

// Grouped List Component with Expand/Collapse
function GroupedList({ 
  items, 
  groupBy, 
  getGroupKey, 
  getGroupLabel,
  renderItem,
  emptyMessage = "No items found"
}: { 
  items: any[]; 
  groupBy: string;
  getGroupKey: (item: any) => string;
  getGroupLabel?: (key: string, count: number) => string;
  renderItem: (item: any, index: number) => React.ReactNode;
  emptyMessage?: string;
}) {
  const [expandedGroups, setExpandedGroups] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  
  // Group items
  const groups = items.reduce((acc, item) => {
    const key = getGroupKey(item);
    if (!acc[key]) acc[key] = [];
    acc[key].push(item);
    return acc;
  }, {} as Record<string, any[]>);
  
  const toggleGroup = (key: string) => {
    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedGroups);
    if (newExpanded.has(key)) {
      newExpanded.delete(key);
    } else {
      newExpanded.add(key);
    }
    setExpandedGroups(newExpanded);
  };
  
  const expandAll = () => setExpandedGroups(new Set(Object.keys(groups)));
  const collapseAll = () => setExpandedGroups(new Set());
  
  if (items.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-center py-8" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{emptyMessage}</p>;
  }
  
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {/* Group controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
          {Object.keys(groups).length} groups, {items.length} total
        </span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button 
            onClick={expandAll}
            className="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono"
            style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}20`, color: COLORS.cyan }}
          >
            Expand All
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={collapseAll}
            className="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono"
            style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}
          >
            Collapse All
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Group sections */}
      {Object.entries(groups).map(([key, groupItems]) => {
        const isExpanded = expandedGroups.has(key);
        const label = getGroupLabel ? getGroupLabel(key, groupItems.length) : `${key} (${groupItems.length})`;
        
        return (
          <div key={key} className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden" style={{ border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
            {/* Group Header */}
            <button
              onClick={() => toggleGroup(key)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 text-left"
              style={{ background: COLORS.cardHover }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {isExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }} />
                )}
                <span className="font-mono text-sm" style={{ color: isExpanded ? COLORS.cyan : COLORS.muted }}>
                  {label}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span 
                className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono"
                style={{ background: isExpanded ? `${COLORS.cyan}20` : `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: isExpanded ? COLORS.cyan : COLORS.indigoLight }}
              >
                {groupItems.length}
              </span>
            </button>
            
            {/* Group Items */}
            {isExpanded && (
              <div className="p-2 space-y-1" style={{ background: COLORS.card }}>
                {groupItems.map((item, idx) => renderItem(item, idx))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function AgentsTabContent({ agents }: { agents: any[] }) {
  const [filterActive, setFilterActive] = useState<string>("all");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<string>("name");
  const [groupBy, setGroupBy] = useState<string>("none");

  let filtered = (agents || []).filter(a => {
    if (filterActive === "active") return a.active;
    if (filterActive === "paused") return !a.active;
    return true;
  });

  filtered = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
    if (sortBy === "name") return (a.name || `Agent`).localeCompare(b.name || `Agent`);
    if (sortBy === "method") return (a.delivery_method || "").localeCompare(b.delivery_method || "");
    return 0;
  });

  const renderAgent = (agent: any, i: number) => (
    <div key={agent.id} className="p-3 rounded" style={{ background: COLORS.bg, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <StatusLamp healthy={agent.active} />
          <span className="font-mono text-sm">{agent.name || `Agent ${i + 1}`}</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>
          {agent.delivery_method || "none"}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <h3 className="font-heading text-lg" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>Agent Queue ({filtered.length})</h3>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <select 
            value={filterActive} 
            onChange={e => setFilterActive(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-mono outline-none"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border, color: COLORS.cyan }}
          >
            <option value="all" className="bg-gray-900">All Status</option>
            <option value="active" className="bg-gray-900">Active</option>
            <option value="paused" className="bg-gray-900">Paused</option>
          </select>
          <select 
            value={sortBy} 
            onChange={e => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-mono outline-none"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border, color: COLORS.cyan }}
          >
            <option value="name" className="bg-gray-900">Sort: Name</option>
            <option value="method" className="bg-gray-900">Sort: Method</option>
          </select>
          <select 
            value={groupBy} 
            onChange={e => setGroupBy(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-transparent border rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-mono outline-none"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border, color: COLORS.cyan }}
          >
            <option value="none" className="bg-gray-900">Group: None</option>
            <option value="status" className="bg-gray-900">Group: Status</option>
            <option value="method" className="bg-gray-900">Group: Method</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {groupBy === "none" ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {filtered.map((agent, i) => renderAgent(agent, i))}
          {filtered.length === 0 && <p className="text-center py-8" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>No agents found</p>}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <GroupedList
          items={filtered}
          groupBy={groupBy}
          getGroupKey={(a) => groupBy === "status" ? (a.active ? "Active" : "Paused") : (a.delivery_method || "None")}
          getGroupLabel={(key, count) => `${key} (${count})`}
          renderItem={renderAgent}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SecurityTabContent({ data }) {
  if (!data) return <div className="text-zinc-500 p-8">Loading security data...</div>;
  const events = data.events || [];
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  
  const critical = events.filter(e => e.severity === 'critical' || e.severity === 'CRITICAL').length;
  const warnings = events.filter(e => e.severity === 'warning' || e.severity === 'WARNING').length;
  const byType = events.reduce((acc, e) => { acc[e.type] = (acc[e.type] || 0) + 1; return acc; }, {});
  
  const filtered = filter === "all" ? events : events.filter(e => 
    filter === "critical" ? (e.severity === 'critical' || e.severity === 'CRITICAL') :
    filter === "warning" ? (e.severity === 'warning' || e.severity === 'WARNING') :
    filter === "info" ? (e.severity !== 'critical' && e.severity !== 'CRITICAL' && e.severity !== 'warning' && e.severity !== 'WARNING') :
    true
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div onClick={() => setFilter("critical")} className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 rounded-lg p-4 bg-red-950/30 border border-red-500/30">
          <div className="text-xs text-red-500 font-bold tracking-wider mb-1">CRITICAL</div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-black text-red-400">{critical}</div>
        </div>
        <div onClick={() => setFilter("warning")} className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 rounded-lg p-4 bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-500/30">
          <div className="text-xs text-amber-500 font-bold tracking-wider mb-1">WARNINGS</div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-black text-amber-400">{warnings}</div>
        </div>
        <div onClick={() => setFilter("all")} className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 rounded-lg p-4 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700">
          <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-bold tracking-wider mb-1">TOTAL EVENTS</div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-black text-zinc-300">{events.length}</div>
        </div>
        <div onClick={() => setFilter("info")} className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 rounded-lg p-4 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700">
          <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-bold tracking-wider mb-1">AUTH FAILS</div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-black text-zinc-300">{byType['auth_failure'] || 0}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {filter !== "all" && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono px-3 py-1 rounded" style={{ background: `${COLORS.cyan}20`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
            Filtered: {filter} ({filtered.length})
          </span>
          <button onClick={() => setFilter("all")} className="text-xs font-mono px-2 py-1 rounded" style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="bg-black border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs">
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-950 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-zinc-500">Security event log</span>
          <span className="text-zinc-600">{filtered.length} events</span>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-600 text-sm">No security events match this filter</div>
          ) : filtered.map((event, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`px-4 py-2 border-b border-zinc-800/50 flex items-start gap-3 text-xs ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-zinc-950/50' : ''} ${event.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'text-red-400' : event.severity === 'WARNING' ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}`}>
              <span className="text-zinc-600 w-20 shrink-0">{event.time}</span>
              <span className={`font-bold w-20 shrink-0 ${event.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'text-red-500' : event.severity === 'WARNING' ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-green-500'}`}>{event.severity}</span>
              <span className="text-cyan-400 w-24 shrink-0">{event.source}</span>
              <span className="text-zinc-300">{event.message}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      <div className="bg-black border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs">

        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-600 text-sm">No log lines match this filter</div>
          ) : filtered.map((line, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`px-4 py-1 flex items-start gap-3 ${line.level === 'ERROR' ? 'text-red-400 bg-red-950/20' : line.level === 'WARN' ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-400'} ${i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-zinc-950/30' : ''}`}>

              <span className="text-zinc-300 flex-1">{line.message}</span>

    </div>

}

          <button onClick={() => setFilter("all")} className="text-xs font-mono px-2 py-1 rounded" style={{ background: `${COLORS.indigo}20`, color: COLORS.indigoLight }}>

          </button>

      )}
      <div className="bg-black border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs">
        <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-950 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-zinc-500">Failure log</span>
          <span className="text-zinc-600">{filtered.length} failures</span>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-600 text-sm">No failures match this filter</div>
          ) : filtered.map((f, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`px-4 py-2 border-b border-zinc-800/50 flex items-start gap-3 ${f.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'bg-red-950/20 text-red-400' : f.severity === 'HIGH' ? 'bg-orange-950/10 text-orange-400' : f.severity === 'MEDIUM' ? 'bg-amber-950/10 text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-400'} ${i % 2 === 0 ? '' : 'bg-zinc-950/30'}`}>
              <span className="text-zinc-600 w-20 shrink-0">{f.time}</span>
              <span className={`font-bold w-20 shrink-0 ${f.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'text-red-500' : f.severity === 'HIGH' ? 'text-orange-500' : f.severity === 'MEDIUM' ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-500'}`}>{f.severity}</span>

            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { 
        setNavLinks(d.links || []); 
        setNavAuth(d.authenticated); 
      })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch("/api/auth-status", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setNavAuth(d.authenticated))
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    };
  }, []);

  const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
    "pencil": PenLine,
    "palette": Palette,
    "settings": Settings,
    "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard,
    "sparkles": Sparkles,
    "share-2": Share2,
    "clock": Clock,
    "briefcase": Briefcase,
  };

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);

}

export default function ZoControlDeck() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("overview");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>({});

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [stats, services, agents, credits, routes, security, logs, failures] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/system-stats").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/services").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/agents").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/credits").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/sites").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/security").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/logs").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
        fetch("/api/failures").then(r => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      ]);
      setData({ 
        stats, 
        services: services?.services || [], 
        agents: agents?.agents || [], 
        credits: credits?.credits || null, 
        routes: routes?.routes || [],
        security: security?.stats || {},
        logs: logs?.stats || {},
        failures: failures?.stats || {},
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
    const timer = setInterval(fetchData, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [fetchData]);

  const renderContent = () => {
    if (loading) {
      return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-t-cyan-400 border-gray-700 rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto mb-4" />
            <p className="font-mono text-sm" style={{ color: COLORS.muted }}>Loading...</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    switch (activeTab) {
      case "overview":
        const { stats, services, agents, credits, routes, security, logs, failures } = data;
        const activeCount = agents?.filter((a: any) => a.active).length || 0;
        const totalCount = agents?.length || 0;
        const svcHealthy = services?.filter((s: any) => s.healthy).length || 0;
        const svcTotal = services?.length || 0;
        const securityTotal = security?.totalApiCalls || 0;
        const securityWarnings = security?.serverErrors || 0;
        const logsTotal = logs?.totalLines || 0;
        const logsErrors = logs?.errors || 0;
        const failuresTotal = failures?.totalIncidents || 0;
        const failuresCritical = failures?.critical || 0;
        return (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <StatCard label="Active Agents" value={`${activeCount}/${totalCount}`} sub="routines" onClick={() => setActiveTab("agents")} />
              <StatCard label="Services" value={`${svcHealthy}/${svcTotal}`} sub="online" onClick={() => setActiveTab("services")} />
              <StatCard label="Routes" value={routes?.length || 0} sub="published" onClick={() => setActiveTab("dashboards")} />
              <StatCard label="Credits" value={credits?.balance?.toLocaleString() || "—"} sub="balance" onClick={() => setActiveTab("credits")} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <StatCard label="Security Events" value={securityTotal} sub="total API calls" onClick={() => setActiveTab("security")} accent="green" />
              <StatCard label="Server Errors" value={securityWarnings} sub="errors" onClick={() => setActiveTab("security")} accent={securityWarnings > 0 ? "red" : "green"} />
              <StatCard label="Log Lines" value={logsTotal} sub="total lines" onClick={() => setActiveTab("logs")} accent="blue" />
              <StatCard label="Log Errors" value={logsErrors} sub="errors" onClick={() => setActiveTab("logs")} accent={logsErrors > 0 ? "red" : "blue"} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <StatCard label="Total Incidents" value={failuresTotal} sub="incidents" onClick={() => setActiveTab("failures")} accent={failuresTotal > 0 ? "orange" : "green"} />
              <StatCard label="Critical" value={failuresCritical} sub="critical" onClick={() => setActiveTab("failures")} accent={failuresCritical > 0 ? "red" : "green"} />
              <StatCard label="High" value={failures?.high || 0} sub="priority" onClick={() => setActiveTab("failures")} accent="orange" />
              <StatCard label="Resolved" value={failures?.resolved || 0} sub="resolved" onClick={() => setActiveTab("failures")} accent="green" />
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      case "agents":
        return <AgentsTabContent agents={agents} />;
      case "services":
        return <ServicesTabContent services={services} />;
      case "credits":
        return (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="p-6 rounded-lg" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-2" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Balance</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-heading font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                {credits?.balance?.toLocaleString() || "—"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 rounded-lg" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-2" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>7-Day Burn</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-heading font-bold" style={{ color: COLORS.indigo }}>
                {credits?.burn_7d || "—"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 rounded-lg" style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-2" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>Reserve (USD)</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-heading font-bold">
                ${((credits?.reserve_usd) || 0).toFixed(2)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      case "dashboards":
        return <DashboardsTabContent routes={routes} />;
      case "security":
        return <SecurityTabContent data={security} />;
      case "logs":
        return <LogsTabContent data={logs} />;
      case "failures":
        return <FailuresTabContent data={failures} />;
      default:
        return (
          <div className="text-center py-12">
            <p className="font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{activeTab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + activeTab.slice(1)} tab - coming soon</p>
          </div>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        .font-heading { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
        .font-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        .font-mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }
        .glass { background: rgba(15,17,23,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
        .hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .hide-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }
      `}</style>

      <div className="min-h-screen text-white font-body" style={{ background: COLORS.bg }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 glass">
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-3 md:py-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 md:gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center"
                style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${COLORS.cyan}, ${COLORS.indigo})` }}>
                <Globe className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
              </div>
              <span className="font-heading font-semibold">Control Deck</span>
            </div>

            {/* Nav */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 -mx-4 px-4 md:mx-0 md:px-0 md:pb-0 hide-scrollbar">
              {TABS.map(tab => {
                const Icon = tab.icon;
                return (
                  <button key={tab.id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono tracking-wider transition-all"
                    style={{
                      background: activeTab === tab.id ? `${COLORS.cyan}15` : "transparent",
                      color: activeTab === tab.id ? COLORS.cyan : COLORS.muted,
                      border: `1px solid ${activeTab === tab.id ? COLORS.cyan + "30" : "transparent"}`,
                    }}>
                    <Icon className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-1.5" />
                    {tab.label.toUpperCase()}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main content */}
        <main className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
          {renderContent()}
        </main>
      </div>
      <GlobalNav />
    </>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value, sub, onClick, accent }: { label: string; value: string | number; sub: string; onClick?: () => void; accent?: string }) {
  const accentColor = accent === "red" ? "#ef4444" : accent === "amber" ? "#f59e0b" : accent === "green" ? "#22c55e" : accent === "indigo" ? "#6366f1" : COLORS.cyan;
  const accentBg = accent === "red" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)" : accent === "amber" ? "rgba(245,158,11,0.1)" : accent === "green" ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)" : accent === "indigo" ? "rgba(99,102,241,0.1)" : `${accentColor}10`;
  
  return (
    <div 
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`p-6 rounded-lg ${onClick ? 'cursor-pointer hover:brightness-110' : ''}`}
      style={{ background: COLORS.card, border: `1px solid ${accent ? accentColor + "30" : COLORS.border}` }}>
      <p className="text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase mb-2" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{label}</p>
      <p className="text-3xl font-heading font-bold mb-1" style={{ color: accentColor }}>{value}</p>
      <p className="text-xs font-mono" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{sub}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import {

  ExternalLink, LayoutDashboard, Settings, Share2, Clock, Briefcase, Sparkles, PenLine
} from "lucide-react";
import { marked } from "marked";

interface Theme {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  mode: "light" | "dark";
  accent: string;
  fontType: string;
  description: string;
  tags: string[];
  keywords: string[];
}

interface ThemeDetail extends Theme {
  prompt: string | null;
}

const MODE_OPTIONS = ["all", "light", "dark"] as const;
const FONT_OPTIONS = ["all", "sans-serif", "serif", "mono"] as const;

function GlobalNav() {
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false);
  const [navAuth, setNavAuth] = useState(false);
  const [navLinks, setNavLinks] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const navRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { 
        setNavLinks(d.links || []); 
        setNavAuth(d.authenticated); 
      })
      .catch(() => {});
      
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch("/api/auth-status", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" }, credentials: "include" })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setNavAuth(d.authenticated))
        .catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (navRef.current && !navRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNavOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    };
  }, []);

  const ICON_MAP: Record<string, any> = {
    "pencil": PenLine,
    "palette": Palette,
    "settings": Settings,
    "layout-dashboard": LayoutDashboard,
    "sparkles": Sparkles,
    "share-2": Share2,
    "clock": Clock,
    "briefcase": Briefcase,
  };

  const filteredNavLinks = navLinks.filter(l => l.path !== window.location.pathname);

  const COLORS = {
    cyan: "#06b6d4",
    cyanLight: "#22d3ee",
    indigo: "#6366f1",
    indigoLight: "#818cf8",
    muted: "#94a3b8",
    dimmed: "#64748b",
    border: "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)"
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="hidden md:block fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999]" ref={navRef}>
        <div className="relative">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setNavOpen(!navOpen)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 backdrop-blur-md transition-colors border"
            style={{ borderColor: COLORS.border }}
          >
            {navOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: COLORS.cyan }} />}
          </button>
          
          {navOpen && (
            <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-3 min-w-[250px] w-max max-w-md rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl"
              style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.95)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}>
              {navAuth && (
                <div className="px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono" style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}`, color: COLORS.cyan }}>
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Authenticated view</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="py-2 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredNavLinks.map((link: any) => {
                  const IconComp = ICON_MAP[link.icon] || ExternalLink;
                  return (
                    <a key={link.path} href={link.path}
                      onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 group">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                        style={{
                          background: link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}15` : `${COLORS.cyan}15`,
                          border: `1px solid ${link.category === "private" ? `${COLORS.indigo}30` : `${COLORS.cyan}30`}`,
                        }}>
                        <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: link.category === "private" ? COLORS.indigoLight : COLORS.cyan }} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">{link.name}</span>
                          {link.category === "private" && (
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider"

                              Private
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs mt-0.5 truncate" style={{ color: COLORS.dimmed }}>{link.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[9999]">
        {navOpen && (

            style={{ background: "rgba(15,17,23,0.98)", backdropFilter: "blur(20px)", border: `1px solid ${COLORS.border}` }}
          >
            {navAuth && (

                    onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)}

          style={{ background: COLORS.cyan, color: "white", boxShadow: `0 4px 20px -5px ${COLORS.cyan}60` }}
        >
          {navOpen ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-6 h-6" />}
        </button>
```
