```tsx
  ".zcmd-log-time{color:var(--copper);margin-right:8px;min-width:70px;display:inline-block}",
  ".zlab{padding:20px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;height:100%;overflow-y:auto}",
  ".zlab-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bord);padding-bottom:8px}",
  ".zlab-tab{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--dim);cursor:pointer;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;transition:all 0.15s}",
  ".zlab-tab:hover{color:var(--bone)}",
  ".zlab-tab.active{background:rgba(192,139,92,0.12);border-color:var(--bord);color:var(--copper)}",
  ".zlab-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:6px}",
  ".zlab-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:16px}",
  ".zlab-input{width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:rgba(232,224,212,0.03);color:var(--bone);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;resize:vertical;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.15s}",
  ".zlab-input:focus{border-color:var(--copper)}",
  ".zlab-input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zlab-btn{margin-top:10px;padding:8px 20px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--copper);background:rgba(192,139,92,0.15);color:var(--copper);cursor:pointer;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:all 0.2s}",
  ".zlab-btn:hover{background:rgba(192,139,92,0.25);transform:scale(1.05)}",
  ".zlab-btn:disabled{opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed}",
  ".zlab-results{margin-top:16px;padding:14px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(192,139,92,0.2);background:rgba(192,139,92,0.04)}",

  ".zlab-result{padding:6px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bord)}",
  ".zlab-result:last-child{border-bottom:none}",
  ".zlab-signal-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}",
  ".zlab-signal{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:rgba(232,224,212,0.02);transition:all 0.2s}",
  ".zlab-signal.found{border-color:var(--verd);background:rgba(93,170,150,0.06)}",
  ".zlab-signal-icon{font-size:24px;width:36px;text-align:center}",

  ".zlab-signal-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zlab-signal-check{font-size:16px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zlab-signal.found .zlab-signal-check{color:var(--verd)}",
  ".zlab-signal-count{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zk-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}",
  ".zk-text{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:700;color:var(--copper);text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--copper);animation:zpulse 1s infinite}",
  "@keyframes zpulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:0.8;transform:scale(1.05)}}",
  ".zk-sub{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:14px;color:var(--verd);margin-top:12px}",
  ".zbrf{padding:20px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;height:100%;overflow-y:auto}",
  ".zbrf-header{margin-bottom:24px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bord)}",
  ".zbrf-greeting{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:24px;color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:4px}",
  ".zbrf-date{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zbrf-section{margin-bottom:20px}",
  ".zbrf-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--verd);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px}",
  ".zbrf-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:rgba(232,224,212,0.02);margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--bone)}",
  ".zbrf-days{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}",

  ".zbrf-day:hover{border-color:var(--copper);color:var(--bone)}",
  ".zbrf-day.active{background:rgba(192,139,92,0.15);border-color:var(--copper);color:var(--copper)}",
  ".zbrf-slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px}",
  ".zbrf-slot{padding:10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:transparent;color:var(--bone);cursor:pointer;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;text-align:center;transition:all 0.15s}",
  ".zbrf-slot:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--copper);background:rgba(192,139,92,0.06)}",
  ".zbrf-slot.active{background:rgba(192,139,92,0.15);border-color:var(--copper);color:var(--copper)}",
  ".zbrf-slot.busy{opacity:0.35;cursor:not-allowed;text-decoration:line-through}",
  ".zbrf-slot-time{font-size:10px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zbrf-input{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:rgba(232,224,212,0.03);color:var(--bone);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;outline:none;transition:border-color 0.15s}",
  ".zbrf-input:focus{border-color:var(--copper)}",
  ".zbrf-input::placeholder{color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zbrf-submit{margin-top:8px;padding:10px 24px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--copper);background:rgba(192,139,92,0.15);color:var(--copper);cursor:pointer;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:all 0.2s}",
  ".zbrf-submit:hover{background:rgba(192,139,92,0.25)}",
  ".zbrf-submit:disabled{opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed}",

  ".zbrf-confirmed-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)}",
  ".zbrf-reset{margin-top:12px;padding:8px 20px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--bord);background:transparent;color:var(--bone);cursor:pointer;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;transition:all 0.15s}",
  ".zbrf-reset:hover{border-color:var(--copper)}",

  ".zstore-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--bone)}",
```

### `/zos-lite` (page, public)

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";

const CALENDLY_URL = "https://calendly.com/zenlytics/discovery-session";
const commandStarters = [
  "What is ZOS?",
  "Show me the judge demo route.",
  "Best projects here?",
  "How can I get in touch?",
];

function safeTimeAgo(createdAt?: string, fallback?: string) {
  if (!createdAt) return fallback || "Recent";
  const d = new Date(createdAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return fallback || "Recent";
  const diff = Date.now() - d.getTime();
  if (diff < 60_000) return "Just now";
  if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.max(1, Math.floor(diff / 60_000))}m ago`;
  if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.max(1, Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000))}h ago`;
  return fallback || d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}

function metricCards(data: {
  now?: any;
  buildLog?: any;
  signals?: any;
  xFeed?: any;
  routes?: any;
  stats?: any;
}) {
  const cards: Array<{ label: string; value: string; note: string }> = [];
  if (typeof data.now?.apps?.length === "number") {
    cards.push({ label: "Apps", value: String(data.now.apps.length), note: "/api/zos/now" });
  }
  if (typeof data.signals?.total === "number") {
    cards.push({ label: "Signals", value: String(data.signals.total), note: "/api/zos/signals" });
  }
  if (typeof data.buildLog?.build_phases?.length === "number") {
    cards.push({ label: "Build Phases", value: String(data.buildLog.build_phases.length), note: "/api/zos/build-log" });
  }
  if (typeof data.xFeed?.posts?.length === "number") {
    cards.push({ label: "X Posts", value: String(data.xFeed.posts.length), note: "/api/x-feed" });
  }
  if (typeof data.routes?.count === "number") {
    cards.push({ label: "API Metrics", value: String(data.routes.count), note: "live API count" });
  }
  return cards.slice(0, 5);
}

function VoiPanel({ onOpen }: { onOpen?: (app: string) => void }) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Array<{ role: "assistant" | "user"; text: string }>>([
    {
      role: "assistant",
      text: "Command Center option A is active. Ask naturally and I will route through Voi-ZOS instead of dead-ending.",
    },
  ]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const ask = async (question: string) => {
    const trimmed = question.trim();
    if (!trimmed || loading) return;
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: trimmed }]);
    setInput("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/voi-zos", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question: trimmed }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        { role: "assistant", text: data?.answer || "I could not get a response from Voi-ZOS." },
      ]);
    } catch {
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: "assistant", text: "Voi-ZOS is temporarily unavailable." }]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="zl-card">
      <div className="zl-label">Command Center</div>
      <h3 className="zl-title">Option A. Natural-language routing via Voi-ZOS</h3>
      <p className="zl-copy">Unknown commands are handled by the assistant instead of failing quietly.</p>
      <div className="zl-starters">
        {commandStarters.map((starter) => (
          <button key={starter} className="zl-chip" onClick={() => ask(starter)}>
            {starter}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="zl-chat">
        {messages.map((message, index) => (
          <div key={index} className={`zl-msg ${message.role}`}>
            <span className="zl-msg-role">{message.role === "assistant" ? "Voi-ZOS" : "You"}</span>
            <div>{message.text}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="zl-input-row">
        <input
          className="zl-input"
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") ask(input);
          }}
          placeholder="Ask about ZOS, projects, fit, or booking"
        />
        <button className="zl-primary" onClick={() => ask(input)} disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? "..." : "Ask"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="zl-inline-actions">
        <button className="zl-secondary" onClick={() => onOpen?.("calendar")}>Open booking</button>
        <button className="zl-secondary" onClick={() => onOpen?.("mail")}>Open X feed</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MetricsPanel({ data }: { data: any }) {
  const cards = useMemo(() => metricCards(data), [data]);
  return (
    <div className="zl-card">
      <div className="zl-label">Desktop Metrics</div>
      <h3 className="zl-title">API-backed only</h3>
      <div className="zl-metrics-grid">
        {cards.map((card) => (
          <div key={card.label} className="zl-metric">
            <div className="zl-metric-value">{card.value}</div>
            <div className="zl-metric-label">{card.label}</div>
            <div className="zl-metric-note">{card.note}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="zl-copy small">No invented counters. Everything shown here comes from live API responses.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function XFeedPanel() {
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/x-feed", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => setPosts(Array.isArray(data?.posts) ? data.posts : []))
      .catch(() => setPosts([]))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="zl-card">
      <div className="zl-label">X Feed</div>
      <h3 className="zl-title">Date rendering fixed in the UI layer</h3>
      <div className="zl-feed-list">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="zl-feed-item">Loading feed...</div>
        ) : posts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="zl-feed-item">No cached posts available.</div>
        ) : (
          posts.slice(0, 6).map((post) => (
            <div key={post.id || post.url} className="zl-feed-item">
              <div className="zl-feed-text">{post.text}</div>
              <div className="zl-feed-meta">
                <span>{safeTimeAgo(post.created_at, post.date_display)}</span>
                <span>{post.date_display}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CalendlyPanel() {
  return (
    <div className="zl-card zl-card-wide">
      <div className="zl-label">Booking</div>
      <h3 className="zl-title">Calendly embed</h3>
      <iframe
        src={CALENDLY_URL}
        width="100%"
        height="800px"
        frameBorder="0"
        style={{ border: "none", borderRadius: 12 }}
        title="Calendly discovery session"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ZosLite() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>({});
  const [activeApp, setActiveApp] = useState<"command" | "mail" | "calendar">("command");

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/zos/now", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      fetch("/api/zos/build-log", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      fetch("/api/zos/signals", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      fetch("/api/x-feed", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      fetch("/api/nav-links", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
      fetch("/api/projects", { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null),
    ]).then(([now, buildLog, signals, xFeed, routes, stats]) => setData({ now, buildLog, signals, xFeed, routes, stats }));
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="zl-shell">
      <style>{STYLES}</style>
      <div className="zl-hero">
        <div>
          <div className="zl-kicker">Safe workaround path</div>
          <h1>ZOS Lite</h1>
          <p>
            A low-risk prototype route for the remaining `/zos` work. It validates the UI fixes and interaction decisions
            without mutating the unstable monolith.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="zl-nav">
          <a href="/zos" className="zl-secondary">Original /zos</a>
          <a href="/about-the-build" className="zl-secondary">About the build</a>
          <a href="/press" className="zl-secondary">Press</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <MetricsPanel data={data} />

      <div className="zl-tabs">
        <button className={activeApp === "command" ? "active" : ""} onClick={() => setActiveApp("command")}>Command Center</button>
        <button className={activeApp === "mail" ? "active" : ""} onClick={() => setActiveApp("mail")}>X Feed</button>
        <button className={activeApp === "calendar" ? "active" : ""} onClick={() => setActiveApp("calendar")}>Book Time</button>
      </div>

      {activeApp === "command" && <VoiPanel onOpen={(app) => setActiveApp(app as any)} />}
      {activeApp === "mail" && <XFeedPanel />}
      {activeApp === "calendar" && <CalendlyPanel />}
    </div>
  );
}

const STYLES = `
  :root {
    --bg: #0b0d10;
    --card: #14181d;
    --card-2: #1b2128;
    --text: #edf0f3;
    --muted: #97a1ab;
    --accent: #c08b5c;
    --line: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at top, #1a1f27 0%, #0b0d10 45%, #07090c 100%); color: var(--text); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .zl-shell { min-height: 100vh; padding: 32px; display: grid; gap: 20px; }
  .zl-hero, .zl-card { background: rgba(20,24,29,0.88); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
  .zl-hero { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .zl-kicker, .zl-label { color: var(--accent); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
  h1 { margin: 8px 0 10px; font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px); }
  .zl-title { margin: 8px 0 10px; font-size: 22px; }
  p, .zl-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; }
  .zl-copy.small { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 13px; }
  .zl-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
  .zl-tabs { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .zl-tabs button, .zl-chip, .zl-secondary, .zl-primary { border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--card-2); color: var(--text); padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
  .zl-tabs button.active, .zl-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #111; border-color: transparent; font-weight: 700; }
  .zl-starters, .zl-inline-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .zl-chat { margin-top: 16px; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  .zl-msg { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
  .zl-msg.user { background: rgba(192,139,92,0.12); }
  .zl-msg-role { display: block; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .zl-input-row { margin-top: 14px; display: flex; gap: 10px; }
  .zl-input { flex: 1; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #0e1217; color: var(--text); padding: 12px 14px; }
  .zl-metrics-grid { display: grid; gap: 12px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); margin-top: 16px; }
  .zl-metric { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
  .zl-metric-value { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent); }
  .zl-metric-label { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .zl-metric-note { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .zl-feed-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; }
  .zl-feed-item { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
  .zl-feed-text { line-height: 1.6; }
  .zl-feed-meta { margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .zl-card-wide iframe { margin-top: 16px; background: white; }
  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .zl-shell { padding: 16px; }
    .zl-hero { flex-direction: column; }
    .zl-input-row { flex-direction: column; }
  }
`;
```

## Variables

| Placeholder | Description |
|---|---|
| `{{HANDLE}}` | Your zo.space handle (replaces `curtastrophe`) |
